What brings the RCM here? To the Wild North? You have a true boiadeiro heart.', "Hidin', gatherin' themselves. The harbour's in full lockdown, friend. No getting in or out... for the time being.", 'No, man. Not today. You have a true boiadeiro heart.', 'He shrugs.', 'Any political movement goes through a period of strife. Shame you got mixed up in it, though.', 'Yet it calls back to an older era, where this was commonplace. You have a true boiadeiro heart.', 'So...', "How'd you like our harbour?", "Right! You talked to the boss, eye-to-eye -- like men of the plain. If you have any more questions, I'm set to talk.", 'Knocked him out good...', 'Like the flying desperado!', "It's that really cool flying desperado spin kick you did, boiadeiro. Often performed by the most hard-bodied boiadeiros on the steppes.", 'He nods energetically.', "So, what's on your mind this time?", 'So, what now?']

The answers lie in *debates*, not in violence.", 'Now, now. To put it simply, they are the ultimate arbiters of la responsabilité in this part of the world.', 'I would offer to connect you with the committee myself, but alas, I am not actually *in* Martinaise.', 'Of course, we are speaking informally, but *officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives...', "That's why it would be extremely irregular, or potentially even *inappropriate* for me to intercede with the Committee concerning a district I'm not officially in.", "Yes, you've made your *persistence* quite clear. But isn't it interesting how humanity always finds inspiration in nature?", 'Well, of course it *is* a heavily armed and armoured warship with a full complement. But I assure you its purpose in Revachol is to *keep* the peace, not disturb it.', "That is part of the idea, of course. The Coalition doesn't want the people of Revachol to feel that they are under a *military* occupation. As I was saying, *officially* speaking I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives...', 'Précisément. *Officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives...', "Why, *officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives. I have never seen the nerve before...', "Does this behaviour represent the RCM's *official stance* toward its Coalition partners?", 'He turns to the lieutenant.', 'Perhaps he does, perhaps he does not. In any case, this conversation is over. But they were very loud and very... Martinaise...", 'He pauses, looking for the right wording.', "Let's just say that the labouring classes can get rather *expressive* with their profanities.", "I couldn't tell you exactly. Why... no... but then, I don't know what a drummer is *supposed* to look like.", 'I went back inside.', 'Officer, the yard was pitch black. There was nothing to see. But I could still hear their voices. They were threatening to kill that poor man.', "All men, I presume. But again, I couldn't see very clearly.", "It's possible, officer, but I cannot say with certainty. It was very dark, you must remember.", 'Those funny... Oh.', 'Officer, that kind of language is unbecoming of an officer of the RCM...', 'I believe they were mostly white, though I believe I saw two Areopagites among them. And I am quite certain that one spoke with a Mesque accent.', "Well, that's the strangest part, officer. *Nothing* happened. There were no gunshots, no celebratory shouts, no anything.', 'The man wipes his glasses.', "You're right, of course. That is what one is supposed to do in such circumstances. I can't say I'm surprised. The fine reputation of the men and women serving in the RCM is well deserved.", "What's the meaning of this?", 'Is your colleague here trying to *arrest me*?', 'Well, I can certainly understand *that*.', 'That hanging was a surreal play. The Coalition doesn't want the people of Revachol to feel that they are under a *military* occupation. That is why the Archer is always careful to maintain a constant, discreet distance.", "You see, in addition to being an airborne artillery platform, Coalition Warship Archer is also the linchpin of the Coalition's surveillance and communications infrastructure in Revachol.", 'And listening! Of course, the Archer has orders to fire on any unidentified aerostatics that might approach it, so it might be safer to get in touch *from the ground*...', "But in that case, you would require a radio transmitter capable of broadcasting on Coalition frequencies. And that kind of technology naturally isn't typically available for non-Coalition use. Yes, it *is* a bit of a conundrum.", "I suppose there might be some way to *circuit-bend* your way onto those frequencies, but you'd have to be one of those *techno-tinkerers* to do it.", "Unfortunately not, no, I don't have the pleasure. I am merely a representative of the Coalition Government, not very well-versed in technology...", "Let me just say that I have *complete confidence* in the RCM. I'm sure you'll figure something out.", 'Unauthorised circuit-bending is a very serious matter with grave security implications, but as of the moment there is no specific law *forbidding* it, in Revachol at least...', 'That, my friend, is your responsabilité. I cannot take it from you, nor can you delegate it to someone else...', "I don't mean to discourage you, of course, just to say that it won't be *easy* to reach the Committee.", "Yes, you've made your *persistence* quite clear. As I was saying, *officially* speaking I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives...', 'Précisément. *Officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives...', "Why, *officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives. I'm only in Martinaise in an unofficial capacity...", "Of course, I'm sorry I couldn't be the 'break' you were looking for. Good luck with the investigation.", "Of course, I'm glad I could help.", 'A moment, officer.', "Do you have everything you need from me? I'm afraid we won't have the chance to speak again once you leave.", "It's against diplomatic best practices for an official in my position to be discussing murders with local militiamen.", "And I'm pressed for time. After you leave, I should be leaving as well.", "Sure, go ahead, it's a beautiful space.", 'Let me know if you have any further questions.', 'Already?', "Well, I'm glad I could help.", 'You have acquired the hat.', 'Keep it, officer, it looks good on you.', 'You have acquired the robe.', 'Keep it, officer, it looks good on you.', 'You have acquired the hat.', 'Keep it, officer, it looks good on you.', "My name is Charles Villedrouin and I'm an official with the Coalition Government. I work for the Institute of Price Stabilité, on assignment from Sur-la-Clef.", 'I heard you talking to my friend outside... Very good. Super. I am here to assist you in any way possible. Ask me about the hanging.', "Oh yes, my friend has a great eye for these things. He refuses to tell me where it came from -- it's a mystery. Hehehe.", "I believe they call this type of frame *industrial*. It's very comfy.", "That's really all I can tell you about it.", 'He forms a little rooftop with his fingers. Cold air sweeps in from the balcony.', "Oh, we got it from an atelier in the East Delta Commerce Centre. Personally I think it's a little culturally insensitive, but the material is great. It's an emblem of the formal normalization of our diplomatic relations.", 'Of course. Let me just say it has been an emotional week for me.', 'He forms a little rooftop with his fingers. Cold air comes in from the balcony.', 'You have acquired the robe.', 'Keep it, officer, it looks good on you.', 'Officers of the Revachol Citizens Militia.', 'The man in business-casual removes his cuff links.', 'First responsabilité, then stabilité, then prospérité!', "The sea air is so invigorating, don't you agree?", 'Lots of opportunities for revitalisation here.', 'Ah, look! A seagull.', 'This whole area is a strong candidate for a micro-loan.', 'Even high-ranking bureaucrats are entitled to a holiday.']

Title: Disco Elysium
Dialogues: ['That means go home, gendarme.', "Yes, that's probably the best way to describe it.", 'Comrade Steban is a great discussion leader. One of the best at the university.', "Precisely. We're not interested in senseless parroting. We like to read *critically*.", 'Ha! As though you can call that pablum *teaching*.', "We're post-attendance, basically.", 'Truly extraordinary.', "And before that, there was Abelard's 'Un Pays Infernal'...", "Only because certain moralists and their ideological lap dogs pretend to object to his more *maximalist* tactics... as though they've never committed any so-called 'war crimes'.", "This gendarme talks just like a moralist. They *love* getting on their high horses about so-called 'war crimes'.", "Abelard's 'Un Pays Infernal'...", 'Obviously.', 'He snorts.', 'We think of ourselves as more of an intellectual vanguard.', 'Seems unlikely, from a strictly infra-materialist perspective...', 'Or even *third*.', "Though historically speaking, the SRV *has supported* direct action against right-wing paramilitary squads, especially when they're doing the Indotribes' dirty work.", 'His companion can barely suppress a yawn.', "His companion's eyes widen as you hold up the ancient weapon.", 'His friend, though, seems oddly unmoved.', "Some of our former comrades didn't have the *ideological fortitude* our work demands.", 'See? Even a gendarme gets it.', "Don't forget about Maurice and the turnips.", 'A gang of cheap psychologists and intellectual midgets.', 'Typical Gottwalders, in other words.', "If only! They've got all the beans accounted for in their asset sheets, their quarterly budgets, their future projections. But for some reason there are never enough beans to go around, so we've just got to cut our bean rations in half...", "Basically indistinguishable from fascists. You'd need an x-ray machine to tell the difference.", '... something of an ideological auxiliary, perhaps.', "But she refuses to submit an essay, so we can't call her a member of the group *per se*.", "It was unbelievable. He said, 'Turnips don't care if they're grown by communists, moralists, or welkin. They grow just the same'.", 'Zuzanna said that he has been hanging out with some non-communists lately.', "He just quit coming. We haven't seen him around for weeks.", "It's a sad reflection on our educational institutions.", "Providing you haven't been hanging out with non-communists, like Maurice.", "She said if she's going to make truly radical art, she needs a suitably radical workspace.", "His companion's eyes widen with interest. He has a cold smile.", "It's too bad she hasn't developed the theoretical foundation to do truly radical work.", 'Besides, it would look pretty bad if people thought we were collaborating with the gendarmerie.', "That's really good, Steban. You should save that for an essay.", 'Hmph. Leave it to the gendarme to enforce bourgeois stylistic values.', "Not as good as Steban's original idea, though.", 'His friend yawns, evidently bored by literal reality.', 'It was just a little *informal* experiment. No reason to take it too seriously.', "It's holding, it's holding...", 'Alright. You go next, Steban.', "Yes. This is the closest we've ever gotten.", 'It is, it is...', '...', 'We should probably clean up...', 'That was remarkable.', '...', '...', 'Undoubtedly.', 'Harder to believe, but still possible...', "It's alright, Steban. That was still *very* close. One of our best performances yet.", 'Damn it to hell!', "It's my fault, Steban. My hands were shaking... Nerves got the better of me.", 'That I did not expect.', 'His companion is blushing now, a sheepish grin on his face.', "What does it say, Steban? I can't see.", "I bet he's never written a substantial essay himself. He's really got no right to critique. None at all.", 'Really just violence in general. I find it *fascinating*.', "Perhaps he subscribes to 'La Fumée'.", "Steban, you can't be serious... for a gendarme?", "If he wants a real critical history, he's got to read 'On the Material Conditions of the Mirovan Boilermakers'.", "Yes, I would say he's got serious potential at least.", "Makes you want to gouge your eyes out. Or better, gouge the author's eyes out.", 'It appears so.', "Thank god we're no Gottwaldians.", "I believe it's 'Man is the mirror of the world'.", "It will turn up, I'm sure. In a way, it wants to be found...", "Steban's right. If it's going to happen, it will happen.", 'Yes, a fascinating case study...', 'But that would imply that whenever you unpeel time you leave behind some kind of *doppelgänger* in now-time...', 'It happens to the best of us.', 'Strange. I thought that women were attracted to a certain amount of revolutionary musk...', "If you encountered it in a novel, you'd say it sounded like a plot contrivance, or like a fantasy.", 'Wait, Steban, are you saying the gendarme is some kind of *future communist*?', "Completely counter to the spirit of 'Wirrâl'. What's even the point?", 'I still like the hill dweorgr for their Master Ironworking feat.', "Steban's welkin is so mega. He's got this umbral stave that gives him *ungodly* bonuses against shadowborn.", "The young man's companion says nothing, but the expression on his face reveals a begrudging respect for your experimental approach to character creation.", 'The irradiated waste tokens have this great metallic ochre sheen.', "With his 'partner', he says.", 'Hmm. Then what does that make the *game designers*?', 'Drip after drip after drip after drip...', "The young man's companion appears to be mashing his fist into his palm.", "'To find victory in the cultural war we must first scout the battlefield'.", "Can't let any of the dreck rub off on you.", "We prefer difficult books. Books that might destroy you, if you don't destroy them first.", "He looks like he's about to puke.", 'Steban, a moment...', "The young man's companion beckons him into a private conference.", "It doesn't have to be a *hard* hit.", 'Just enough to leave a mark.', "is to show Maurice and those other traitors that we're the only reading group *hard core* enough to tangle with the RCM...", 'Steban? Are you alright?', 'Yes, this worked out quite nicely.', 'He seems immensely pleased with himself.', 'Steban, can you hear me?', 'It seems the face of violent reaction has revealed itself...', 'His companion leans forward, ready to jump in...', "In 'Innocence of Capital', Puncher and Wattmann argue that communists must possess as little capital as possible, in order to keep their thinking *undiluted* by its influence...", 'Yes. One of our better discussions lately, on the whole.', "He probably won't get a better chance, honestly.", "It means you're not a communist, in other words.", "Steban, it's getting pretty late.", "Mazov says it's the arrogance of capital that will be its ultimate undoing. It does not believe it can fail, which is why it must fail.", 'Mazov tells us to laugh at the monster that hides behind false hopes and pieties.', "And of course, we'll be shooting right back.", 'He wants to know if women are bourgeois, Steban...', 'His companion nods, but offers no further solace.', "He says he doesn't have any questions, Steban.", "See, Steban? I told you there's no such thing as a gendarme communist.", '...', "We've tried it ourselves, but thus far we haven't been able to absorb more than the preface and table of contents.", 'Sleep well, gendarme.', "That's interesting. I thought people *loved* group interviews.", 'Though *some of us* maintain that advertising is an unacceptably bourgeois tactic.', 'I suppose that makes it a historical inevitability, beyond contradiction.', 'Hmmm, I guess no one could accuse Cindy of having a *bourgeois aesthetic*.', 'Hmmm, it *does* sound pretty cool when you describe it like that.', 'See? Even the gendarme agrees.', 'When nothing could be further from the truth.', 'Hmm. I thought the *cloak-and-dagger routine* made us seem more appealing.', 'I suppose we have read through most of the infra-materialist canon by this point.', 'As long as we maintain the appropriate critical distance.', "Exactly what I've been saying. On fundamental matters there can be no compromise!", "Precisely my point. It's about quality, not quantity.", "It is, it's holding!", 'He should know the meeting starts at 22.00 *sharp*.', 'His companion looks up at you and squints.', "Hey, Steban. Isn't that *your* jacket?", "'Those committed to the rights of property are those most apt to violate them'.", 'His companion nods emphatically.', "He'll shit himself! Positively.", "It doesn't sound like he's done the reading, Steban.", 'Maybe he can explain himself.', "The young man's companion reflexively snorts at the mention of Gottwaldians and Econoclards.", "The communards didn't commit *enough* atrocities.", 'Yes, exactly.', 'Completely right, Steban.', "I can't believe someone just left these matchboxes here.", "This new translation of 'Reál and Reality' is garbage.", 'University is a lot better once you stop going to class.', "I'll spit in Maurice's face when he comes crawling back.", 'Eight cups a day is perfectly healthy.', 'I would commit war crimes for some real Saramirizian coffee.', 'Another coffee, Steban?', "Don't worry, I'm sure your jacket will turn up."]

Oh, I haven't been asked that question for such a long time.", "I don't meet a lot of people outside my circle these days...", 'Anyhow, my name is Roustame Diodore -- investor, licence holder, and extremely high-net-worth individual. And you are?', "It is an odd name, to be sure. There's something... rather grim about it.", 'I must admit, the name suits you very well.', 'Public service is a noble cause.', "Though I'm sorry to hear a good man like yourself is in servitude to the drink. But then, nobody's perfect.", "Though I'm sorry to hear a good public servant like yourself is in servitude to *the drink*. A man can't serve two masters, in my experience.", "Oh, don't you worry, lieutenant. I can tell a good man when I see one.", 'I am surprised -- in a positive manner, do understand -- about your exceedingly high-net-worth name.', "Though I'm sorry to hear a good man like yourself is in servitude to the drink. But then, nobody's perfect.", 'Public service is a noble cause.', "Though I'm sorry to hear that a good public servant like yourself is in thrall to the drink. A man can't serve two masters, in my experience.", 'The man chuckles.', "It's quite alright. I'm used to the question by now. To be blunt, I inherited my fortune from my grandmother, who, herself, was an extremely high-net-worth individual back in Graad...", 'All I did was take her fortune and invest it prudently. Believe it or not, it takes more than a bit of skill not to blow a vast fortune on sailing boats, bad choices, and *unsupervised* state policy.', 'The man exhales with a whistle.', "I gotta tell you, at first, being rich is a lot of work. You've got to work hard because everything's so darn expensive. You know, prices increase exponentially at this income level...", "But then, once you've reached my position, it's nearly impossible for me *not* to make money. My assets are so diversified that I'm bound to come out ahead no matter what...", "It is, truly. It's almost entirely care free.", 'It really leaves you time to better yourself spiritually.', 'Capital.', 'Makes one speechless, does it not? Blinds like the sun that rises from beyond the horizon after a gloomy winter.', 'Precisely! You know, I hear people talk sometimes about *economic equality* and *fairness* and all that kind of stuff. But tell me, where would we be without liberalism? In caves! Whacking each other with bones!', 'Exactly!', 'A world of slavery and violence. Which brings us back to the essential truth of modernism...', 'Where we are right now, the freedom of mankind can only be derived from the free flow of capital.', 'A nightmare scenario. A world of slavery and violence. Which brings us back to the essential truth of modernism...', "Which one? Revachol, where I nominally reside? Or Graad, where my father emigrated from? Or Ile-de-Casherbrume where I've registered my shell companies?", "Listen, if capital and nationalism went hand in hand, there'd be no need to ask the question...", 'States are akin to boulders in a river, slowing the free flow of ideas. Given enough time, the water will wear those boulders down.', "Maybe I should? Sadly, I've never been there. I'm sure it's nice but in the end -- does it matter?", "And that's, what? Unjust? I think it's perfectly just.", 'His tone is ever-so-slightly less agreeable than before.', "Listen, I used to be an idealist, just like you. But the truth is that we have no objective system by which to measure someone's value other than the market. We should just embrace that, rather than resist it...", 'The hand that allocates resources among men is invisible and cruel, but it is *steady*, *measured*, indeed it is *just*.', 'Sure, and they benefit when I buy things to stimulate the economy. Do you know how many jobs it takes to build and maintain a racing yacht?', "*Dozens*, at least. Of course, in the future it'll all be automated. But my point is this...", 'he says, jabbing his finger into the air a bit...', "Every man gets what he earns. It's the height of tyranny to take that from him.", 'One would imagine living such a high-net-worth existence is overwhelmingly exciting, but yes, as you now see... it can sometimes just stun you with its boredom.', 'Go right ahead.', 'The man chuckles.', 'To be perfectly blunt, I inherited my fortune from my grandmother, who, herself, was an extremely high-net-worth individual back in Graad...', 'What do you mean?', 'His... essence seems to signify actual surprise.', 'Are you talking about my chin?', "Oh, *that's* what you mean. Yes, I've heard of this effect, though I've never witnessed it myself, of course. It has something to do with our Weiss-Wiesemann coefficient.", "Among other things... but calm down, I'm but a lowly single-digit billionaire.", 'No, not really. There are actually quite many digits.', 'Yes. I imagine that *does* look strange to you. My container.', "That's good.", "It's some statistical thing. In essence, it says that when an extremely *low*-net-worth individual meets an extremely *high*-net-worth individual, some of the laws of physics cease to apply.", "Hm. I've never heard anybody say anything about my chin. Yet I know that people often tell each other half-truths, things they think the other party would wish to hear...", 'Being rich does not make one impervious to the human condition. Maybe I do have a strange chin and you are the first person to call me out on this. Not that you should. But you did. For this -- I am grateful.', "Go right ahead, don't be shy.", 'Oh, alright then. Another question.', "Travelling! This is a great way to get around -- it's fun, it's safe, and it gives me lots of time to think...", 'By the way, let me now ask *you* a question: Where are we, exactly?', 'Ah, a fellow history buff! I, myself, am currently reading up on Franconigerian-era trains. Very interesting stuff.', "It's a shame I can't get out and explore myself. One of the downsides of being an extremely high-net-worth individual is that mobs of low-net-worth individuals are constantly banding together to ask for money.", "There simply aren't enough hours a day to hand out all the handouts. It's like feeding seagulls. There are always more, and they never seem to do anything interesting with it -- except more seagulls.", "Spending money is a matter of desire, I'm sure you agree. I don't have the desire for spending it like that.", 'Smart, no? It also provides a means to hide from all the targeted advertising we extremely high-net-worth individuals are constantly subjected to...', "What? No, I didn't say that at all. Being rich is great. Just don't tell anyone I told you that.", 'The bending light appears to *wink*.', "Don't get me wrong: They're nice things, but once you achieve a certain level of wealth your time and mental space become *much* more important than material goods.", 'Go right ahead.', "Ah, Revachol. I remember walking its streets as a teenager. There used to be a bowling alley in Stella Maris... I wonder if it's still there?", "Ah, interesting. I've made quite a few real-estate plays over the years.", "Was it Kras Mazov that said 'religion is pyrholidon for the masses'?", "He may have been a communard, but we're in agreement about that. Still, I imagine the architecture is quite lovely.", "Well, as we say in my circle -- one person's crushing business failure is someone else's development opportunity.", 'He smiles.', "Never mind then. We'll just have to be on equal footing, geographically speaking.", "It's perfectly alright. Based on your appearance I can tell I'm dealing with a smart man...", 'As you may know, us high-net-worth individuals do not have a lot of cash on hand. Investments and liquidity are enemies of one another -- I think I only have coins for coffee machines.', "Here's three reál, how much can you get for this?", "That's the idea, my friend! You've got to work for the rest.", "Maybe you can make that money grow? Come up with an investment plan? How's that sound?", "You're welcome. You know...", 'His eyes narrow, the light seems to bend more *aggressively*.', "Yes, I'm sure. You know...", 'His eyes narrow, the light seems to bend more *aggressively*.', "It's perfectly alright. Based on your appearance I can tell I'm dealing with a civilized man...", 'Come now, there is not even a scent of corruption here. I am merely being polite... so let me check my pockets.', 'Sure! Let me check my pockets.', 'A youth centre, huh? What *kind* of youth centre?', "Brilliant! Without children who'll be there to buy stuff in the future?", "When life closes a door, it opens a window, yes? What's the expected return on this?", "Very impressive. You've got a natural eye for unusual investment opportunities.", "I don't normally do this without a formal pitch deck, but to hell with it, what's the point of being rich if you have to follow all the rules?", "Here's a round of seed funding. This should be enough to prove out the concept and get things off the ground.", "Ah, yes. Now you're displaying it... the *eccentricity* that becomes a wealthy individual.", "If the money-saint's visage weren't wrapped in physics-defying light, you would see his approval.", "Remember: it's not a *handout*, it's an investment. And I expect to see returns.", 'Now, was there anything else I could help you with?', 'the man thinks for a moment.', "I like that you're thinking about the future, but couldn't the centre have a more... economic focus?", "No, no, no. You've got to think *bigger* than that.", 'Intriguing. Go on.', "I think I follow you. You're saying I should invest in exotic financial derivatives? Or maybe some kind of real-estate play?", 'But what do you say to those who claim that the assets underlying those derivatives are overvalued? Does that pose a systemic risk to the wider capital markets?', 'You said that already.', 'Yes, yes, but the question is how do we take advantage of those fluctuations?', 'Yes, every school child hears that. The question is how do *we* get more of that money?', "The man pauses, considering your words. The light bends and swims around his face. You cannot tell what he's thinking...", 'Trust... yes...', 'Such a simple truth, yet so easily forgotten. What is money, anyway, but an idea in our heads we all *trust* one another to believe in?', "I'm very impressed. You have a deep understanding of the world that few men ever attain.", 'But real-estate is an illiquid asset. What happens if you need a short-term capital infusion and all your holdings are tied up?', 'Go on.', "I'm ready.", 'Hold on. Have we met before?', "Yeah, on second thought, it couldn't have been you.", "Your idea reminds me of a group of young men who came to me a long time ago, calling themselves 'Fortress Accident' -- the name should've been a red flag.", 'They pitched me and a handful of other investors on an idea for a role-playing game that would, in their words, change the world.', 'Well, at first everything was rosy, the ideas were solid, but they were lacking in... how do I put it...', 'They lacked the *will* to get things done. As their financial situation became more desperate, their ideas devolved from realistic to absolute insanity.', "We lost all of our money. High-art types never deliver. They're only good for peddling welkins or whatever creeps they come up with.", "Nobody knows for sure, but the place can't be pretty.", 'Sadly, when we got there, it was too late. The concept had run out of steam, only dust remained.', "What I want to tell you is this: it's a very bad idea. Dead in the water. You seem like a reasonable man, but that is not a reasonable plan.", "You're welcome. Now, was there something else I could help you with?", 'Absolutely not.', "No, on second thought, it couldn't have been you.", 'Yes?', 'The volunteer police force? And why would I do that?', "You know, that's *exactly* what I've heard. From what I understand, the RCM as currently constituted is essentially a lost cause...", "Still, the idea of a privatized police force is *extremely* forward thinking. You could even say it's *ultra* ultraliberal...", 'Tell me, if you could invest in the RCM, where would you direct your resources?', "I'm listening.", 'The shape stands in stunned silence.', 'It is not possible. But what a dream...', "Either way, even if I could do it, I certainly wouldn't give an incompetent and corrupt police force *WORLD-ENDING* weaponry.", "I think the lieutenant's right. Your problems run much deeper than equipment or funding. The entire org structure of the RCM needs to be redefined. You need a unified chain of command, new metrics for measuring performance that reward real *police work*. Does that sound right?", 'Hell no! Can you imagine how much work that would take? Why would I do that when I can just speculate on exotic financial derivatives from the comfort of this shipping container?', "The thing about investing is that the less work you have to do, the better. Don't over-think. That's what return on investment means.", 'Now, was there anything else I could help you with?', "Precisely, which is why I'm not going to do it. Why would I do that when I can just speculate on exotic financial derivatives from the comfort of this shipping container?", 'But I appreciate the *grandiosity* of your ideas. Thus you might understand -- the entire org structure of the RCM needs to be redefined. You need a unified chain of command, an end to petty spats between precincts, new metrics for measuring performance that reward real *police work*. Does that sound right?', 'You need to think *bigger*. The entire org structure of the RCM needs to be redefined. You need a unified chain of command, an end to petty spats between precincts, new metrics for measuring performance that reward real *police work*. Does that sound right?', "You want to take an incompetent and corrupt police force and give them *deadlier* weapons? No, no, that won't work...", "The RCM's problems aren't the kind you can solve with *radiocomputers*. The rot goes much deeper than that...", "Hmm. I don't believe in giving anyone money for nothing, but maybe there's something to using *market incentives* to improve performance...", 'Hmmmm, a tried-and-true strategy for increasing the perception of value without improving the underlying asset. Not bad. But still...', "That's why I *should* invest? Are you trying to say that the RCM's bad reputation makes it an undervalued asset?", "I'm already on the board of two major arms manufacturers. I've got no shortage of guns, if I wanted such things...", "I don't believe in handouts, especially for people who *volunteered* for their positions...", 'There it is. I knew it as soon as you did the Milton 32-8 knock. A fellow entrepreneur!', "Well, you've already convinced me to invest in you, so please, go on -- tell me about this opportunity. I'm keen.", 'Yes, the special knock that helps us ultras identify each other. I almost forgot it myself.', "But I'm getting side-tracked. Tell me about your business proposal. I am all *ears*.", 'His face seems to distort in the blinding light, pulling and twisting at his sides.', "A painter, eh? I am always looking to expand into new asset classes. Who's the artist?", 'A-ha. And the name of the piece?', 'He leans in to take a good look at the rectangular plastic board coated thick with emulsion.', "There's no sign of a reaction for a good three seconds. Then...", "Wonderful things aren't they -- names? They can completely change your reading of a person. Or, in this case, a painting.", 'Before I invest, I need to know more about the work. How do I know this asset is going to appreciate with time?', 'It lets you *immerse yourself* in a modern school of thought? Are you sure?', "*Dangerous*? I like things that are dangerous. You could even say I'm one of these 'adrenaline-junkies'.", 'The light emanating from him seems to intensify.', "Well, I think that settles it. You've found a buyer, my friend. A pleasure transacting with you.", 'The light around him warms you like a friendly embrace.', "However, there are a few *complications*.... I don't have the cash on me right now to pay for art of this calibre. What I can instead offer are shares in Mauer-Koshlai Mercury Group.", "They are the very *unit* of capital. You can buy them, sell them, even sit on them if you think it wise. Trust me when I say this -- becoming a shareholder means you're part of the *big leagues*.", "I bought these shares many years ago for a steal. As predicted, Mauer-Koshlai Mercury's operating profit has increased year on year, and there's no signs of it slowing down. People *always* need mercury.", "Which means you could net yourself a considerable profit if you need some immediate liquidity. But if you don't mind waiting I expect the value of these shares to double within the next five years.", "It's a Gottwaldian-Iilmaraan company that specialises in extracting mercury. It's seen massive growth lately due to the discovery of rödfärg mercury.", "Have you heard about it? At the moment, it's trading at more than 1.5x the price of gold. That's because it's an essential component in the next generation of radiocomputers...", "Rehm's using it in their next model. I can't wait for mine to turn up! My predictions say its improved speed and azimuthal range should increase my trade efficiency by a whopping 46%. You really should order one if you don't want to be left behind.", 'Splendid.', 'You hear the sound of expensive fabrics brushing against each other. When it stops, a roll of paper emerges from the radiance.', "This is a stock certificate. Well, a photocopy of one. Nevertheless, it's solid proof that you own shares in Mauer-Koshlai Mercury Group.", "The light around the individual in front of you changes somehow as you take the scroll. You can't figure out what's different -- you just know that it is.", "That concludes *our part* of the transaction. Once you've turned over the asset, my people will get the legal ball rolling.", "Another deal complete. Welcome to the big leagues! If you haven't already, I'd advise you to consider hiring a Personal Brand Strategist.", "What *don't* they do?", "They practically do everything -- from spotting good investments and analysing design trends, to booking a lunchtime table at the prestigious L'Ambroisie.", "Unfortunately not. I only know the ones who work with multi-millionaires and beyond. But take a look around and I'm sure you'll find one. Personal Brand Strategists are attracted to money like *sharks* to blood. You'll find having net worth opens many new doors for you.", "So! What's next on the agenda?", "Not a problem. The offer stands for as long as I'm around these parts.", 'Sounds like a hell of a trip. I really must experience it for myself.', 'The light emanating from him seems to intensify.', 'I appreciate you saving us from wasting time. Is there anything else I should know about the painting?', 'Just a mixing palette? But where does the value lie then?', 'That changes everything.', "Perfect! I've been looking for a way to communicate without the information being intercepted or stolen by rivals.", 'What an original idea! By drawing our focus away from the final piece we gain a new appreciation for the craft behind it. An art in its own right that is usually hidden from us.', "Go on. I'm listening...", "Emerging? That's a word with plenty of appeal. What is it that defines this style exactly?", "Hm. Seems unhygienic. Is that what's *in* these days?", 'But perhaps I judge too quickly. Is there an intelligent reasoning behind the method?', 'He swills it around in his brain.', "So it's an éxtrasomatic painting. An effort carried out by physical instinct -- not the mind.", 'Perhaps I *have* been neglecting the triumphs of anatomical perspicacity lately...', 'He sinks into thought.', 'I see. What is so special about it then?', "I see -- very good. What kinds of issues are we talking about? I've really got into the housing crisis recently.", 'Poor thing! In that case, buying this will help me fulfil my *noblesse oblige* for the month.', "Oh yes, I see it now. Very *graphic*, isn't it? Really delivers insight into what it's like being that... unruly.", "That's a shame. Is there anything else to this painting, or is that it?", 'But design is the very signature of humanity. Everything we do is design. Text columns, urban architecture, the precise shape of a stapler... what are we without any of that?', "Hmm, I do cling to it rather a lot. Perhaps that is one of my shortcomings -- I just haven't realised it before now.", 'That prophet-for-hire did say I should identify weakness and remove it from my life...', "Hm. I hadn't thought about it that way before. You might have just opened up a new door in my mind.", "Perhaps I could be the one to 'discover' it? To share it with the wider world...", "That's what I wanted to ask you about. Tell me, what's their *story*? Did they *suffer*?", "An artist's value doubles if they come with a good backstory. I thought you were an experienced art dealer, you should know this.", 'Pray tell.', 'The human shape within the light appears to lean even closer. Tiny dots flood your retina as the shipping container gets too bright.', "Any details? I've heard some struggling families have to sell their organs to pay the rent. There is also the terrible misfortune of having to go get your own groceries when you're poor. Which one is it?", "*Mesque bangers*? No! Have I told you I've stopped reading the news? It's too negative, can't let it affect my mojo.", "I've found it's much better for my health just to throw money at those kinds of problems and hope they go away. That way I don't have to feel guilty about avoiding them.", '*Every day*?', 'But how does she find time to do any work?', 'What a sad, sad story. I should ask Rhéa to look into this, maybe the foundation can set up some scholarships for cases like these.', 'Just a hollow husk...', 'The blinding light becomes almost melancholy.', 'Oh.', "Well, I'm sure her work represents some very interesting *internal* struggle. Probably with mental illness. Yes, that sounds right.", 'In any case, is there anything *else* you can tell me about this piece?', 'Oh.', "Well, I'm sure her work represents some very interesting *internal* struggle. Probably with mental illness. Yes, that sounds right.", 'You?', 'But why should we care about *you*?!', "You mean even *you* haven't looked at it?", 'Still, only two people have seen it thus far. That makes it pretty *exclusive* and therefore potentially valuable.', "And if I don't buy it now, more people will see it -- ergo its value will drop.", "I see, so by artificially constraining supply you're also stimulating demand. I have to say, it's a brilliant strategy...", 'I see...', 'The light appears to concentrate...', "I'll be honest, all I see are splatters that lack any true intention.", "Please, if there's something I'm missing, I'd love to know what it is.", "There's no sign of a reaction for a good three seconds. Then...", 'Keith? Just *Keith*?', 'he repeats.', "Keith, I like it. One of my nephews is named Keith. We haven't spoken in years, since I declined to pay for his most recent trip to rehab. But perhaps this will help patch things up between us...", 'Not even a pseudonym?', 'The light appears to vibrate with surprise.', "Original. I don't think any of my friends have any pieces from anonymous artists. Or maybe only Luca, the son-in-law of the Comte de L'Ys.", "No, not even him. He might have some Moelles and de Vignys, the *authenticity* of which historians are debating, but I don't think that counts. Perfect.", 'And the name of the piece?', 'He leans in to take a good look at the rectangular plastic board coated thick with emulsion.', "The art market, you say? Possibly. As I said, I don't carry much money on my person, but do go on -- what are you thinking?", "The art market, you say? Sure. 'Hit me with it', as they say. I'm keen to hear what you have in mind.", "The art market? Intriguing. You've already convinced me to invest in you, so please, go on -- tell me what you're thinking.", "The art market? Intriguing. Well, as I said, I don't carry much money on my person. But do go on, what are you thinking?", "Ah, a fellow entrepreneur. Tremendous! The art market? Intriguing. Sure, I'm keen. What are you thinking?", 'They could set you up for a *long time*. Mauer-Koshlai Mercury is just getting started. Mark my words.', "The pleasure was mine. Unfortunately, I must be away soon. The next time we meet, I'll be expecting an update on my investment!", 'Farewell, friend, and may your peace of mind guide you to happiness.', "It was a real pleasure. Sadly, though, my current lifestyle prevents me from remaining more than a brief time in any one place. Perhaps we'll meet again, somewhere far away...", "Thanks for stopping by. If you ever have an idea you want to pitch me, I'm all ears.", "Why go so soon? I feel we've so much more to talk about. Ah, well. Until next time!", "The man stands at the far end of the shipping container. It's hard to say anything more about him. You cannot make out any of his details, but you do feel the overwhelming presence of... capital.", "Something's amiss. The light beams bend around his face and scatter in a thousand directions. It seems the laws of physics do not apply here. They are suspended, distorted, an echo.", 'In the general stillness, only your tongue moves, flickering as you utter...', "Welcome! Come in, make yourself at home. Sorry I'm not better able to receive you -- I wasn't expecting visitors today.", 'Now.', 'What can I do for you, good sir?', 'Welcome, welcome! Not too much, actually, just pleasantly surprised to have company today.', "It's all about money, you know.", 'You gotta spend money to make money.', 'Money is what *really* matters.', "They say money can't buy you happiness...", "...but that just means you don't have enough money.", 'You have to invest your money wisely.', 'You can buy stocks with money.', 'And then use those stocks to make even more money.', "That way you'll have enough when you grow too old to make new money.", 'Real estate is the graveyard where tired, old money goes to rest.', 'Money is what literally makes the world turn.', 'The laws of money are just like the laws of nature.', "Unpaid labour doesn't net you any money.", 'There is no such thing as free money.', 'Money is all about numbers.', 'Money is actually all about trust.']

Title: Disco Elysium

He has a special room for that -- *and* a special costume!", "Dad's fighting with sticks every night after dinner for four hours. Title: Disco Elysium
Dialogues: ['Oh, hello, officer.', 'He covers his mouth, struggling to suppress a coughing fit.', "I'm afraid not, officer. I've been busy digging around in the reeds for days, looking for signs of insect activity -- I'm less interested in mammalian concerns, to be perfectly honest.", 'Good, okay...', '*Completely* empty?', "The cryptozoologist's eyes grow wide.", "That's not *ideal*, but...", 'He rubs his chin.', 'I definitely left that one stocked. Hmm...', "Yes! The *phantasmodea* picked off the locusts and escaped. This is good news! Though we'll have to reconsider the design of the traps, make them *more* secure...", 'Of course -- be *sarcastic*.', "Unless you have an *alternative* hypothesis you'd like to venture, mine stands, okay?", 'Actually, no...', "Excuse me for getting emotional, this is a big deal for us. You've helped us *twice* now -- and brought some great news, too. My gratitude, *and* the gratitude of the Société Cryptozoologique de Revachol, is yours.", "Hmph. I appreciate your concern, *officer*, but please leave this to the *experts*. Unless you have an *alternative* hypothesis you'd like to venture...", "Thank you for the vote of no-confidence, Gary. And *officer*, I appreciate your concern, but please leave this to the *experts*. Unless you have an *alternative* hypothesis you'd like to venture...", "The cryptozoologist's face flushes with indignation.", 'Of course we have!', "You're right, dear.", "It's a fair point. But what other explanation could there be?", "Pardon me. This is... a big deal for us. You've helped us *twice* now -- and brought great news too. My gratitude, *and* the gratitude of the Société Cryptozoologique de Revachol, is yours.", "I'm fine, Lena...", "And I definitely won't have a heart attack. Rather a cough fit...", 'Yes-yes -- *and*?', 'So it *was* just a child...', 'He purses his lips, crestfallen.', "Yes, you're right. We just need to restock the empty trap. Then we'll need to inspect the traps one more time, and then *maybe*... we can...", 'The ageing cryptozoologist breaks into a hideous coughing fit.', "You're right, you're right...", "We can come back next season... when it's warmer...", "You're right, dear. We'll get our shot yet, I'm sure of it...", "You're right, Lena. The RCM is worth their salt -- more so than they say on the radio.", "Really, it's too much, officer...", 'He starts coughing again.', "Here's a fresh batch of locusts. They should slide right down the funnel. And thank you again. We will definitely mention you, should this lead to a discovery. I'm not talking co-discovery, of course, but...", 'What the devil is a Cuno? And why would he be making a *city of bugs*?', "No-no. No need to apologize, Gary. You've been more than helpful. We'll have to take a rain check on that game of 'Suzerainty' today though -- we're gonna follow this through.", 'What the devil... Why would kids be making a *city of bugs*?', 'What the devil is a Cuno? And why would he be making a *city of bugs*?', 'Kids? What would a *child* want with bugs?', "*Autocannibalistic locusts*? I appreciate your *unconventional* thinking, officer, but really, cryptids aren't your area of expertise.", 'A *different* cryptid?', 'The cryptozoologist furrows his heavy brow.', 'Really, officer, we can take it from here.', 'The cryptozoologist furrows his heavy brow.', "Hmm! Well, first of all it's damn difficult to find -- which is why we've been knee-deep in the reeds laying traps for it.", 'Good question. Being a phasmid, of the order *phantasmodea* -- a ghost insect -- it disguises itself as plant-matter. In this case the reeds...', "Awful lot of reeds around, aren't there?", '*And*, I suspect it may also have developed other *specialized techniques* to protect itself from predators... or scientists, in our present case.', "It's my hypothesis that it has evolved certain electro-chemical defences that allow it to interfere with animal perception -- impeding pattern recognition, confusing the visual cortex.", 'But I cannot describe how these defences work -- much less how they evolved -- without studying a live specimen.', "No -- that is precisely what we're *not*. We are zoological specialists, looking for an extant species of phasmid.", "I'm expecting it to be quite giant. One known species of phasmid, called the *megaphasmodea zhouensis*, is about the size of a grown man's forearm. But to study it and its defences, find out how it's stayed hidden so long...", 'He shakes his head.', "Very little, I'm sorry to say. No one's ever captured a specimen, so all our information is based on first- and third-hand accounts.", "He holds up an index finger. That's what makes it a *cryptid*.", 'the cryptozoologist says, brusquely enough that even he seems taken aback by it...', "I've heard enough first-hand accounts to believe quite firmly that the Insulindian phasmid is more than mere superstition.", "Yes, the most *recent* sighting was by a couple of teenagers along the coast here. To stay hidden is a cryptid's primary quality. Title: Disco Elysium
Dialogues: ['Need a hand with that?', 'The surgeon watches her for a moment, pulling on his cigarette.', "You know, it's not so cold that you're going to get frostbite without your gloves.", 'Gottlieb. What is it now?', "There's not the slightest hint of wanting to know the answer in that familiar raspy voice.", "Yes, there's no end to the misfortunes fate has seen fit to rain upon me.", 'Basking in your glory, yeah. Practically drowning in it. Please, tell me what your complaint is before I am completely submerged.', "For you it probably is. I'm counting on my lungs outliving your liver by a wide margin.", "Not that that's anything to fête.", "Oh, spare me the sad drunken blubbering and get on with it. What's your complaint?", "Then let's get on with it. Clock is ticking.", "*Who* you are? You lost your human visage a while back. Now let's get on with it -- I've got more important things to do.", "Firewalker? Yes, yes you are. Just don't breathe in the general direction of your fire-feet. Actually, wait...", '...do exactly that. Put yourself out of your misery. Take a deep diaphragmatic breath in and...', 'You hear an exaggerated inhale and a long exhale on the other end of the line.', "I'm the most serious person at this station, detective. Now, do you have any *current, pressing* medical problems?", "I see third-degree burns and a referral to a plastic surgeon whom you won't be able to afford. But that's in the future. Do you have any *current, pressing* medical problems?", 'Please wonder on your own time. Now, do you have any *current, pressing* medical problems?', 'Sounds more like a newspaper headline that will surprise absolutely no one. Now, do you have any *current, pressing* medical problems?', "From what I can tell, you're just playing into their hands -- disabling yourself from doing any actually useful work. Now, do you have any *current, pressing* medical problems?", "Didn't. But now I do. How's the drinking going?", "Great to hear it. Stop by some time when you're done with your case -- I'll draw some blood, run it through -- let you know how much 'forever' your liver's going to give you.", 'Great. Have a medal. I have an autopsy to attend to. An autopsy of one Chester McLaine, who died of *fish poisoning*.', 'Great. I have an autopsy to attend to. An autopsy of one Chester McLaine, who died of *fish poisoning*.', 'Hard to tell exactly what it was over the phone. Could be a combination of peripheral neuralgia and high blood pressure. Could be that you were having a heart attack...', '...or, actually!', 'It could be *both*, given your profile.', 'Yup.', 'Yes. Probably in more ways than one.', 'Cut down on the drinking, pal. In fact, cut *off* the drinking. The drugs too. Anything else?', 'Yes, positive thinking is a well-known cure-all. My suggestion is to exercise a lot.', "That's because you're hungover -- even the radio waves coming from your direction smell like liquor.", 'Do you feel like your eyes are twitching too?', "That's the tiny vessels pulsating from high blood pressure, stupid officer. You might be sustaining permanent damage to your vision as we speak. Not much I can do about it. I'm not an *eye* doctor.", "The busy kind. It's not life-threatening, just annoying. For you. I've got more important things to do here.", 'Good. It would be an awful nuisance if your experiments with your blood pressure were to cause permanent damage to your vision. A nuisance to you, that is.', 'And you survived it! Congratulations. Are you mobile?', "Even better! Anything else? I wouldn't worry about that. Officers your age have coronary trouble all the time. Also -- death is a natural part of life.", "With all the damage you've been dealing yourself with drugs and alcohol, I'm not surprised.", "What else? I'm not a *brain* doctor. Look on the bright side -- you've got a whole new life now. Use it wisely.", 'Look, pal -- getting *pumped and dumped* is not a disease. People live through it all the time. You should be happy for her.', "That's what the guys say, officer. That some chick pumped you -- and then dumped you. Threw you away like an empty juice carton.", 'You must have me confused for a close personal friend... I am not. I am a medical professional -- with a constant *idiot* emergency on my hands.', "Ah, it's you. Walking, talking, though?", "Great! How's the drinking going?", 'Great! Any other complaints?', "Oh, it's you. I know a woman skilled at that sort of thing over in Jamrock... but I wouldn't want to inflict you upon her. Best of luck, detective.", 'What, you want me to do blood work for you again, tell you just how bad things really are *across the board*? You want another rundown of everything collapsing inside your body?', "You want the real, honest-to-god truth? Stop drinking, eat magnesium and vitamin D. Our station is not a retirement home. We don't have the funds to deal with *rock stars* past their prime.", "And no, I *don't* want to hear a *political commentary* on the topic. In fact -- I've got work to do. Some idiot has glued his eyelids shut with Cyanoacrylate. It looks like Mack Torson.", "Do that. I need to go. Some idiot has glued his eyelids shut with Cyanoacrylate. It *looks* like Mack Torson, but it's hard to say because his eyes are swollen...", 'Mhphm.', 'The phone clicks. Suddenly you hear the already familiar voice...', "Gottlieb. What'd you get yourself into this time?", 'The question is followed by the sound of someone taking a long drag.', "Gottlieb. What'd ya want?", "It's you."]

Chaos in action. Contingencies of our limited existence. It's too late to turn around now.", 'You crazy motherfucker.', 'Unity.', 'Do it for the masses, do it for the crew.', 'His friend forms a fist with a screwdriver still in his hand. Approvingly so.', 'Yes, *you* should do it, detective.', 'It would be good for the sines.', 'The Amnesia.', 'Good, we have too many opinions anyway.', 'Why not? The crab-man has *ideas*, Acele. Ideas from another level of consciousness!', 'Like that Dolorian word for the world, you mean? Elysium...', '*And* short. *And* memorable!', "Egg's right, they can call it 'No Truce' if it's too long. At least it stands out from the others, it *evokes* something, it's victorious.", "It's settled, then. Everyone, welcome to Revachol West!", 'He looks around the church as light beams paint the dance floor violet blue.', 'The Return. I like the sound of it.', "It's settled, then. Everyone, welcome to THE RETURN!", 'He looks around the church as light beams paint the dance floor violet blue.', 'The young man with earrings looks at you suspiciously.', 'Place is a shithole.', 'Burnouts!', 'He angrily spits on a screw, then starts cleaning it.', "Also, they don't heat or clean the building. Like I said, the sines coming off this whole project are seriously uncharted...', "Don't know how much juice we've got, so we better get to it. You ready?", "Good. Title: Disco Elysium
Dialogues: ['The woman looks at nothing, her eyes closed and her lips moving.', 'Huh?', 'What is it? What do you want?', 'Diamonds.', "But wouldn't it be marvellous if I was?", 'She shrugs.', 'Whatever stupid things they put in the lorry, I imagine.', 'I quit concerning myself with that a long time ago.', "Besides, I don't drive the lorry for the cargo, if you know what I mean...", "Oh, it's so much more than *high* where I go, xerife. It's *low* -- I go to the bottom...", 'She closes her eyes in reverie.', "Then it's contraband, lawman. What? Do you want to take an old woman in? Be my guest. Lock me away like Bad Hand Hermenegildo.", 'Of course it does -- what did you expect?', "Of course you don't.", 'Is that all you wanted to know, lawman?', "Of course not. To truly understand the boiadeiro, you need to listen to 'On the Western Plain'.", "It's an old ballad about a young girl who falls in love with a daring boiadeiro. He promises to marry her as soon as he returns from the Western Plain.", 'Of course not. The boiadeiro returns from the Western Plain a *changed* man. One night, as he and his beloved are out walking along the River Magritte, she pleads with him to give up his riding and settle down...', 'So the boiadeiro strangles his beloved and throws her body in the Magritte. Then he rides off, because the Western Plain is calling to him.', "You have to understand -- a true boiadeiro needs a whole horizon to himself. He can't be tied down by man or woman. His beloved was selfish. She didn't know what it meant to love a *boiadeiro*.", "The *most* beautiful -- a true boiadeiro needs a whole horizon to himself. He can't be tied down by man or woman. His beloved was selfish. She didn't know what it meant to love a *boiadeiro*.", 'No, the boiadeiro strangles his beloved and throws her body in the Magritte. Then he rides off, because the Western Plain is calling to him.', "Don't be stupid. The boiadeiro returns from the Western Plain a *changed* man. One night, as he and his beloved are out walking along the River Magritte, she pleads with him to give up his riding and settle down...", 'The woman sways her wrinkled shell back and forth, a strange grin across her face.', 'She cups her ear and leans forward.', 'Did you just call me a *lady*, xerife?', "The woman's malevolent cackling fills the roundabout.", "I'm a lady like you're Gabriel Buenguerro -- only in dreams.", "I'm terrifying to small children. And to those who used to know me.", 'Because they can no longer recognize the person I once was.', "The big ones. The tracts. There's no women and men there, it's all just...", 'She hums along, as if to a track on repeat...', "'In the middle of this town there's a ghostly motorway -- it takes all the people where they want to stay'...", 'How should I know? Do I look like I spend a lot of time with the other camionneurs -- sniffing around -- when I have my movies to go to...', '*O sim*...', 'The woman stares at you, her mind elsewhere now, on other matters.', "I'm only terrifying to small children. And to those who used to know me.", 'Did you just call me a *lady*, xerife?', "I'm not that either, *xerife*.", "I've gone too far from it all to remember what was between my legs. It doesn't work like that on the *long haul*.", "You hear that, lawman? I don't think your partner likes you spending too much time with me...", "Oh, don't worry about me. I'm one of the best camionneurs around. I drive routes no one else will.", "Lomonossov's Land. Udachnaya Zemlya. The Western Plain...", 'She nods and closes her eyes again, letting her mind submerge...', 'The Trans-Katla Magistral. U41-A. As Estradas do Mirador. All the good ones. The deep trenches. Where the bluebirds fly.', 'She opens her eyes again and shudders.', 'She looks you over and scoffs.', "You're right, lawman. *I'm* the one who should take *my* health more seriously. Thank you for looking out for me...", 'Is that all you woke me up to say?', "You go right ahead, lawman. Let me know when you find them. I can't wait to read their *report*...", 'Irmão...', 'I already *am* dust.', 'Some of them. Some of them are like home to me now.', 'I would say the routes I drive are *usual* to me.', 'A pale dream, is what it is.', 'She nods her head according to a rhythm known only to her -- staring at the photo in her hands.', 'What do you mean?', 'Yes. What about it?', "Because I'm one of the best camionneurs around, that's why. I drive routes no one else will.", 'And what *is* that?', 'She sticks a filterless cigarette into a cigarette holder and reaches for the light.', 'No offence, but *your partner*...', 'She lights the cigarette, a white and silver cloud of smoke disappears into her mouth.', '...seems like a bit of an idiot.', 'She breathes out. The air tastes sweet.', 'Neither is pale transportation.', 'Life is transitory.', "You're the opposite of me, then. I remember everything -- even things I never knew.", "The smell of liquor on Gabriel's lips after the shoot. In the motor park. The roses on the day of Franconegro's coronation. On the grand stairs of Raehl. The smoke from the fowling piece, when Dolores Dei was shot...", "The look on her face -- like an orgasm. The wound in her chest. My hand in my father's hand...", 'Except I never had a father. And I never shot Her Innocence Dolores Dei.', 'Heroic doses, *xerife*. Heroic.', 'Thought insertion? *Dithering*? The Graad-Katla Magistral?', "There's a kind of wonder there -- a *sad* wonder. But... at first I had to make a living. Now...", "When you've seen it all go *away* like that. Rolling off like the sea. And then come back to this...", 'She gestures at the square: the broken horse monument, the shadows of the machines in the night.', "What are we *doing* here? For thousands of years, Gabriel... It doesn't have to be like this. We can just give up. We can just become vapour.", 'Like looking into the ocean at night. In the dark.', "You cannot see it but you know it's there. And it's big -- bigger than anything. Bigger than all the other things combined.", "Nothing. Until it starts. When you're deep enough -- then, for me... it's like autumn. Dark grey and orange, the orange of streetlights and the colour of trees in the electric light. It smells like autumn too. It smells terrible.", "Beautiful... it's beautiful.", "In the belly of an airship, behind steel windows -- so you don't look straight into it. It's not *advised* to look into it.", 'No -- the same one. A *roller*. They all are nowadays. Special wheels for connecting to the floor of the hold.', 'She points to the machines, clumped up like toys.', 'Yes.', "*Xerife*, what you understand wouldn't fill a pamphlet...", "You don't need to turn back time. The pale is already churning with it. As the tide of pale rises, so does the past. Someday both will cover the whole world. That's it. That's the story.", "And that's just fine with me. I don't mind becoming vapour. I *like* vapour...", 'She gathers a cloud of smoke in her mouth, then slowly exhales.', "If you wait long enough, it's going to be much more than just 'love'... It's going to be the entire history -- vapourised.", "They say there is a point -- one that *I* have not crossed -- in the pale superdeep. If you stray too far off course on the U41-A, or in Lomonossov's Land... where every step you take is one step further from home, no matter the direction.", "It's a point you cannot come back from. Your mind becomes so radiant with the past -- there is a flip.", 'Instead of writing, it erases memory. Nearing some kind of...', 'Indescribable *finale*.', "She looks at her cigarette, it's almost out. She has swallowed it hungrily. Then at you...", "It's a story us longhaulsmen tell -- longhaulsmen, *xerife*, not *paledrivers* -- way beyond the established pale that's lit by radio frequencies. Where it goes silent.", 'And dark. And the process begins. Erasure. Kilometre by kilometre. In any direction. The Motorway South is a road you cannot come back from.', "'They say I've been away on a kind of holiday'...", 'She replies, silently.', "I've only glimpsed the beginning.", "I've only felt it in the distance. When I was a child...", 'A child. Rowing on the lake.', 'A sigh escapes her lips, then silence, as she stares within herself.', "When you've seen it all go *away* like that, rolling off like the sea, and then come back to this...", 'She gestures at the square. The broken horse monument, the clanging of machines in the distance.', 'Thought insertion? *Dithering*? The Graad-Katla Magistral?', "It's more than dangerous -- it's *sad*. But... at first I had to make a living. Now...", "Like Gabriel Buenguerro in 'Segure-me, Paraíso'...", "You're the opposite of me then. I remember everything -- even the things I never knew.", "You *are* an idiot. And you're keeping me here. Glued to this racket. Unless there was anything else...", 'She puts the cigarette out and stares at something in the distance.', "Like Gabriel Buenguerro in 'O Céu Dourado'...", "You're the opposite of me then. I remember everything -- even the things I never knew.", '*Oh meu deus*, the Lawman solved the case...', 'She lights the cigarette. A white cloud of smoke disappears into her mouth.', 'And here I was thinking you were an idiot.', 'So, are you? An idiot, I mean.', 'Some jamboree you turned out to be... You have about a third of the jawline of Gabriel Buenguerro, and none of the balls.', 'She smiles.', "Now what do you want with an old woman's boots, *xerife*?", 'She raises her boot, slowly -- with contempt -- and says.', "I'm starting to think you should let me get back to Gabriel Buenguerro. You're no Gabriel...", "She's wearing sturdy worker's boots made of black leather. Buckles run across. The sole is also made of leather.", 'Just before Gabriel it was the coronation of Franconegro -- now *there* was a real man...', 'There is no aberration in the pattern that you can see. She puts her foot down.', "And then it was no more. And I was no longer holding my father's hand. He was no longer descending the stairs in Raehl. The crowd had gone silent.", "Perhaps it was another *xerife* who came and woke me up, looking at my boots, asking questions? Or perhaps it was one of the others in this *carnaval*. I don't remember.", 'They fit well on the pedals.', 'she smiles. They fit well on the pedals.', 'Please?', "I think you should let me get back to Gabriel Buenguerro. You're no Gabriel. Gabriel doesn't say please...", 'What do I need drugs for, lawman? What I see, what I *feel*, the Great Adversary... no drugs can compare.', 'Yes. There is a *protagonista*...', "And an *adversário*. I am on the side of the Adversary. There's no coming back from that haul.", 'She glares at you.', 'Oh, this *xerife* is a smart one.', 'Who the fuck is Evrart?', "*Ah*. And what do I care about the Union boss? He's not Gabriel, he's not Franconegro. He's not even Hermenegildo the Hand.", 'Her shoulder bones crack as she shrugs.', 'Maybe. Probably not. Makes no difference to me either way.', 'Just this month I made half a dozen trips from Saramiriza to Graad, on the U41-A. What do you think they take from Saramiriza to Graad, lawman?', 'No, lawman. Diamonds.', 'She grins.', 'I would never make fun of a real lawman, *xerife*.', 'Diamonds are good for you, lawman. You should try them sometime. Make yourself pretty like Eva Deshoras.', "Easy. It's the skinny man who thinks he's a poet -- never trust a poet...", "Also, he's the only one I can see from here.", "Where do you want me to go? This isn't so bad. I can listen to music, or the seagulls. Look at all the colours and the features of this world. It's a good palate-cleanser, this jamboree...", 'Or -- I can just relax and let my mind carry me back where it will. To the great plains...', "It's diamonds, lawman. Obviously.", 'She grins.', "Good. I don't care about drugs. Little molecules. They're nothing.", 'She glances wistfully at the photo.', 'Your *mãe*, lawman. What of it?', 'Why would I want to do that?', 'Lawman... what in the name of god are you talking about?', 'Then what *were* you getting at?', "If you don't know, pfft!", 'She flicks her wrist in a gesture of casual dismissal.', 'Yes -- go. Enough jamboree. I need to get back to Mesque...', 'Her voice trails off.', 'You caught me at an opportune moment. This awful weather keeps me awake. You can entertain me with your questions.', 'The woman is still hunched over the railing, her head swaying to the music, her eyes looking at nothing in particular.', 'The woman still has her eyes fixed on the photograph in her hands. In the background, the radio plays.', 'Nothing. Her smile just keeps widening; her hair is grey like lead.', 'Where am I? Who are you?', "Like a magician recalling a subject from hypnosis, you've jolted her back to reality.", 'The men have small jaws and everything is made out of plastic. Why do you need plastic?', 'When you can make the world out of amber?', 'Back in Mesque during the time of the Revolution.', 'The sidewalks and cafes are filled with young people... I was on my way to see a new boiadeiro picture starring Gabriel Buenguerro.', 'Until you came along, that is.', 'The look she gives you is accusatory.', '*This* is Gabriel Buenguerro...', 'She shows you the photograph in the lavish amber frame.', "A strikingly handsome man looks straight at you, his head crowned with a wide-brim hat. His hair is dark as an oil slick and his jaw is the most perfectly chiselled thing you've ever seen.", 'He was the biggest star of his day. Girls used to faint in the aisles of the cinema whenever he came on the screen, and school boys used to memorize all his lines...', "She leans back, savouring the world she's conjured up.", '*Someone* was...', 'She nods as though her meaning were perfectly clear.', "They are someone's memories, boy.", "What difference does it make if it's me or not?", "They're beautiful. That is all that matters. Beautiful and true -- and they will win. They're *coming* for this, you know...", 'All of this.', "I wasn't dreaming. I was *there*, lawman. It was early spring and 'The Man Behind The Black Sun' had just come out. The posters were twenty metres tall. Everything was golden...", 'Her eyes narrow and she appears to take your measure.', 'While *you* people were tearing each other apart over your petty little Revolution, in Mesque it was a golden age.', "Why not, *xerife*? It's not like I have anything better to do in this hellhole.", 'She settles back against the railing of her motor lorry. Behind her, mountains of memorabilia, photos, and knicknacks line the dashboard.', "Then I don't suppose you could tell me where we are, lawman?", 'No response. Wherever this woman is, your words fail to reach her.', 'The small wrinkled woman does not greet you. She nods along to something on her radio. A photograph is clutched in her hands and there is a warm smile on her face.']
