Won't bring her back, will it now?", "You always confused her, couldn't let us be happy...", 'Seduced her with your fancy words and *pastries*.', 'He suddenly remembers *you* are still there, falls silent, and turns away.', "I don't mean to keep Gaston's tongue from your rectum, officer, but do you actually have any *police* business with us?", "When the dissidents come to *rape* our country, he hides, but try to get a bite of his dear sandwich and he gets claws? You're a special kind of a vermin, Gaston.", 'The only one you have.', "Yes, that's what you need, Gaston. More padding on that fat ass of yours. I hope your heart gives out.", 'What?!', 'The old soldier scowls at you, unamused.', '*Bon sang*, son. You must have a loose screw up there or something.', 'Sounds like you really mean it.', "Alright, I will entertain this... *fantasy*, if you tell me, what interest does an RCM officer have in... 'time travel'?", "It's always about love, isn't it?", "But it's never *only* about love, so what else, officer?", 'The old soldier nods.', 'Even after the Revolution, after the Beachhead, there was a chance. Had we just stayed true to our *values*...', "It happened slowly, like a seedling growing into a tree. Tiny incremental steps. Imperceptible till the thicket was so thick you couldn't clear it with a flamethrower...", "It really does, doesn't it?", 'But honestly, why?', "The 'right track'? This *is* the right track! The only track.", 'This is the world we shaped, a reflection of what we are: cowardly, ugly, and numb.', "And there are no second chances. We don't deserve them! You can't just go back and restart -- that would make everything *MEANINGLESS*!", 'A shadow of pain comes over his face.', "You catch the old carabineer's gaze slowly leaving his opponent's wrinkled face as his dark eyes meet yours -- whatever turmoil raged in him a moment ago is quelled for now.", 'Our lives are unique, and I have neither the means nor the will to help you change that.', 'But I will gladly assist you with police matters.', 'The old carabineer looks at you with wary expectation.', 'Where?!', 'His head drops between his shoulders he snaps around with surprising speed.', 'Goddamnit, son...', 'As an officer of the law you should know better than... damn it! Are we done here?', 'W-war?', 'I mean yes. Yes... It changes men, changes lives and uh...', 'What the hell are we talking about here, officer?', "Look, we just want to play our game, so unless there's something else...", 'Wh...? Oh, I see.', "You're a comedian after all. Funny guy. *Unpredictable*.", 'Alright, you got your laugh, ruined my concentration and our game... Anything else you want, or can we start a new one?', "That's just *typical*!", 'All you young guys these days. You want to be opinionated, controversial, opposition leaders...', "But as soon as the talk turns real and there's a smallest amount of friction you're suddenly 'not gonna say anything'. Better to be wrong than a goddamn coward!", 'Oh save it.', "Men don't have substance anymore, I know that, but seeing such spinelessness in a man bearing an insignia...", 'Enough yacking!', "We have a game to finish, so let's get back to it, unless there's something else?", "*Imbécile, un putain d'imbécile*...", 'The old veteran clutches his chest and tries to steady his breathing.', "*Imbécile, un putain d'imbécile!*...", 'The old veteran clutches his chest and tries to steady his breathing.', 'Anything else you want or can we get back to our game?', "*Imbécile, un putain d'imbécile*...", 'The old veteran clutches his chest and tries to steady his breathing.', "'This time'?!", 'What happened to the first time? Did you make a mistake? Did you *fuck up*? Everyone did!', 'Exactly what history needs.', 'More drifters, confused wanderers, weightless men...', "There are no second chances in life. We don't deserve them. This is the world we shaped -- a reflection of what we are. Wasted, ugly, and numb.", 'Forensic techniques are your forte, not mine, officer.', 'Find another fool, I will not be part of your... joke.', "I thought you were a busy man, officer. Or at least you should be, so I won't comment on this... eccentricity. Now what?", "Unfortunately, I don't.", 'Unlike most of the locals, I have no qualms about assisting law enforcement, but this affair has passed me by completely.', 'In Martinaise, the Union is the law, so can you really blame them?', "*Cop* is a pejorative term. I don't have a problem with policemen. On the contrary, I admire the effort to bring order to our streets.", "I'm confident they are indispensable in regard to all the paperwork and other administrative duties.", "No man can afford to turn his eyes to the horizon if his rear isn't secured. If the womenfolk take care of that, then men can tackle the bigger issues.", "Well, I'm glad at least some people bearing your insignia have kept a level head in these turbulent times.", 'he says, adjusting his cap.', "But you must agree that Nature, in her infinite wisdom, has made men more fit to perform certain... more *challenging* tasks, don't you, officer?", 'Really, officer?', 'Match an average woman against an average man in a dark alley and see who comes out on top.', 'Gender equality is a very noble, very *modern* idea, but in real life, primal roles prevail. But I do not wish to discuss this matter further.', "No reason to even feel bad about that, it's just the way of the animal kingdom.", 'I am merely stating that Nature, in her infinite wisdom, has made men more fit to perform certain... more challenging tasks than women.', 'Remaining headstrong, making tough decisions on the spot, or even tackling physical obstacles are a few examples of such *challenges*.', "There's no point in getting angry at nature, officer. This is just the way we are *made*.", "Let's just say that in the last eighty-two years I have repeatedly seen my beliefs confirmed in full.", 'Gaston here is the same. A weathervane. Never stood up for anything in his life either.', "If I knew, I would not be *afraid* to tell you. I simply don't. I am an old man, not a coward. The daily business of the riff-raff no longer concerns me.", 'Sure, officer.', "Let's hear your *take*.", "I'm not following you.", 'The man stares at you, silently frowning.', 'The carabineer crosses his arms and spits in the crater.', "You're talking about getting black-out shitfaced drunk and going into delirium, right?", 'he asks impatiently.', 'How so, then?', 'He leans in with his hands on his hips.', "And I thought getting my knee shattered and surviving on rat carcasses in the trench was bad... here, have one of my medals! You've earned it, *officer*.", 'The veteran of numerous armed conflicts extends his right arm with the *Setting Sun* in his clenched fist and an expression of utter disbelief in his eyes.', 'Was there something else you wanted to take from us?', 'The veteran extends his right arm with the sun-shaped medal. It glimmers in his wrinkled and scarred palm.', 'Can we get back to our game now?', "Was the vessel you boarded the 'HMS Commodore Red'?", 'You mean alcohol?', 'This deity of yours has quite the following in Martinaise...', 'None as zealous as you it seems, though.', 'Yes, from the looks of it you deserve a medal for the *excellent* handle you have on things.', 'Here, have one of mine!', 'Everyone can see that, yes.', 'Was there anything else, officer?', 'he asks impatiently. Looks like they both want to continue the game.', 'The twelve-year-old junkie, whose alcoholic father beats him?', 'Why did you do that?', 'this is unacceptable for anyone bearing an insignia. A man should lead by example, not terror.', "If you don't have any more questions we'll return to our game now.", "By the looks of it he's still trying to wrap his head around what you told him.", "The carabineer stares at you with a frown. Doesn't look like he's buying it.", 'Please stop.', 'Son...', "I don't know why you're feeding me this horse shit, but I'm not biting. Can we get back to our game now?", "I'm not gonna dignify this with an answer.", "We're gonna get back to our game now if there isn't anything else, officer?", 'The old soldier shakes his head in disapproval.', 'What do you want, officer?', 'Really?', 'What was the unit?', "I'll stop you right there, son.", "I'm old, but I'm not stupid. I *know* a soldier when I see one.", "We'll get back to our game now if you don't mind.", "That's what I thought.", "We'll get back to our game now if you don't mind, *officer*.", 'Mhmh...', "We'll get back to our game now if there isn't anything else?", 'Are you asking me or telling me?', "That's what I thought.", "We'll get back to our game now if you don't mind.", 'Good call.', 'Think we can get back to our game now?', "He won't care.", "As long as there's food in his fat belly, he'll lick any boot that's kicking it to him...", '*Now* you are talking sense, son.', 'All three of us, working as a group -- we can make a difference.', 'Agreed. What about the whole group?', 'I propose *Épées de la Couronne* -- Swords of the Crown, in honour of my old unit.', 'How about what?!', 'Judging by his tone the old carabineer really wanted to honour his old unit.', "It's dignified. I like it. We need dignity. And you...", 'Get excited.', "It's weird. I don't like it. We'll go with mine for now and you...", 'Get excited.', "It's dignified. We need dignity. And you...", 'Get excited.', 'Goddamnit...', "I thought I had you measured, but you can't really measure a slug, can you?", 'Goddamnit, son...', 'Once you realize Martinaise -- all of Revachol -- is *actually* going to shit, it will be too late.', 'he utters through clenched teeth and turns his back to you.']

So what will it be?', 'Now you want it or not?!', "Three-hundred reál and it's yours, as promised.", 'Best shit around!', 'So what do you want then?!', 'Aye, the mind...', '...plays tricks sometimes. Title: Disco Elysium
Dialogues: ["Suddenly, your entire body is paralysed. Aggressive white noise fills your skull -- a strange pain like you've never felt before. Through the static, you hear a woman's voice.", 'says the shadowy figure by the machine.', "Can't say it's a pleasure, officer. I was really hoping *not* to make your acquaintance. But -- here we are.", 'Really now? Check this out!', 'She turns the dial in her hand.', "You're overwhelmed with a new surge of violent static. It feels like a blood vessel exploded in your brain.", "I'm using a pale latitude compressor. You and your partner have been caught in its field.", '*Saw my equations*?', "You've been sniffing through my lorry, right? I expected as much. I *am* a bit surprised you knew what you were looking at...", 'A pale latitude compressor is used to sort of... make the pale more manageable. With a lot of these, you can force a radio signal grid on the pale -- literally crunch the distance across it.', 'Signals are relayed across a series of repeater stations fixed to buoys.', 'Not a fun job, manning those stations. All alone out there in the pale, people lose their minds in just a few years.', "Precisely. This is an industrial-strength paraboloid. It's meant for forcing dimensions on something that doesn't *have* them. Needless to say, the frequencies used are... out of this world.", "At the upper limit is the large prime number generator station. It's used specifically for pale latitude compression. That's why you may be hearing some numbers. But you might also hear -- or think you're hearing -- local radio chatter.", "The pale? It's the end of the world.", 'I built it myself.', 'She nods toward her torture device.', 'Oh yeah. *Way* beyond.', 'She studies her death ray and the law officials trapped in it.', 'No -- once I shut down the compressor, the pain will end.', "It may take a few minutes for you to steady yourself, though -- it's a bit like waking out of a very confusing dream.", "Yeah, I stuck my head in there before using it on you. It seemed like the *ethical* thing to do. Can't say that I enjoyed it. The field was weaker, but I can imagine what you're going through.", "Yeah, let's not talk about *that* shit. You were hunting me and fell into my trap instead. That's all there is to say about it.", "If you've got something *really* important to say, you can do it through the white noise.", 'Goddamnit.', 'She regards you and Kim with sudden sympathy.', "Fine, if you really want to talk, I can dial it down. I've also got a gun, by the way.", 'She steps reluctantly out of the shadows. The pain lessens.', 'She chuckles.', "Now they're going to put on a show before meting out punishment.", "Even though those assholes gave me up... I'm worried for the boys.", 'And you -- watch out for yourselves. You seem to have a habit of walking into traps.', "I'm guessing you don't know that a third mercenary has come to town just in time for the tribunal -- now you do.", 'As I said -- watch out.', 'She nods.', "I'm asking myself that right now too. Anyway, I'm guessing you don't know that a third mercenary has come to town just in time for the tribunal -- now you do.", 'She sighs.', 'Yeah. The mercenaries are about to set up a tribunal and execute someone for killing Lely.', 'I was listening in on their frequency.', "Even though those assholes gave me up... I'm worried for the boys.", "I heard you in the passages. And I've been preparing for quite a while.", "So you found my shack, huh? I'm not surprised.", 'So nice.', "That's one knife I didn't want to find in my back.", "This could've turned out pretty bad for me if you hadn't walked right into 25 bands of ultra-high frequencies.", "I was. Before I caught you in the pale latitude compressor. I'm fine now.", "Not anymore, no. This could've turned out pretty bad for me if you hadn't walked right into 25 bands of ultra-high frequencies.", 'Yeah? What?', "No, I didn't do it. I only helped stage the lynching. Though I doubt that makes much of a difference to *you*.", "he wouldn't have broken first...", 'Oh.', 'I knew the kitten had claws, but not like this...', "I'm sad to hear that. The girl was playing some dangerous games, but even with what she did to me... I wouldn't have wished *that* upon her.", 'She frowns.', "She had some pretty messed up people after her. She's going to come out of that meat grinder a different person... If she comes out at all.", "But Klaasje couldn't have known I was here. How did you?", 'She pauses, taking it in.', 'Well, fuck. And those guys *liked* me -- I know it. If this is what happens to people whom people like...', '...how the fuck do the rest of you get by?', "I did, didn't I. And now you've come for me.", 'But fuck them all the same.', 'Like what?', "I already told you I didn't do it.", 'What shit?', "I told you I didn't do it. Sounds pretty simple to me.", '*My* boys?', 'She looks at you incredulously.', 'What is this? I thought Titus and I had a decent collegial relationship...', "Oh, it doesn't even matter. How can they be *my* boys when they're not even my friends. And those guys *liked* me -- I know it. If this is what happens to people whom people like...", 'She looks at you incredulously.', "What? I don't even understand what you're trying to get at here.", 'Aw, fuck. Took some convincing my ass. And those guys *liked* me -- I know it. If this is what happens to people whom people like...', "Oh, I wouldn't have wished that upon her... The girl was playing some dangerous games, but even with what she did to me... I wouldn't have wished *that* upon her.", "But she couldn't have known I was on the coast. How did you find me?", 'Oh.', 'Well, I guess I always knew she was a *survivor* above all else.', 'She smiles bitterly.', "Nah, she didn't crack. She's a survivor. If she told you anything, it was to save herself...", "How should I know? As I keep saying, he already had a bullet in his head when I got to him, and there hasn't been any useful gossip over the radio...", "Who hasn't?", "You know, I can still see him there, in Klaasje's room, lying on his side.", "He was still warm, but the blueish light coming through the broken window made him look as though he'd been dead for a good long while...", 'She eyes you warily, as though gauging your sincerity.', "Alright, don't kill yourself over it. I was shooting the shit with Hardie and the boys over a few beers, like always. Then Klaasje comes in, all pale and shuddering...", 'She sits down with a drink, trying to steady her nerves. So I grab a seat next to her.', "Oh yeah. *Super*. But I didn't think too much of it at first -- I'd seen her party hard before.", "No, I really didn't. She's not that easy to read. I just assumed she'd done too much blow. It wouldn't be a first for her. But -- no such luck. She was in some *deep* shit.", "She asked me to come upstairs -- the merc she'd been going with was lying on the bedroom floor, dead. I knew she couldn't get the authorities involved. So, yeah...", 'What? No. Faking a lynching was her idea.', 'Yeah. In cold blood. It really surprised me -- how quickly she was able to get a hold of herself once we got up there. It was like she was another person. The *party girl* was gone.', 'She asked me to help her drag him into the shower so she could wind the shower head around his neck. To fake lividity. Then she dressed him while I went to get the Hardie boys.', "Yeah, I wasn't sure whether to admire her -- or be disturbed.", 'And potentially bring attention to herself? No. Besides, the shot was made from a distance -- otherwise we would have heard it downstairs.', '...war?', "The thought crossed my mind. But the mercenary's death was going to have repercussions either way. Although, the way things are going...", 'Eh, fuck it.', "I'm not responsible for these people after what they did to me.", "I really don't care which one of us you think was more at fault for the 'lynching.' Neither of us killed him, though.", 'The shot was made from a distance -- otherwise we would have heard it downstairs. Besides, she had good reason to not draw attention to herself.', "I saw *you* roll into town. I wasn't about to stick around for questioning by a goddamn La Puta Madre agent.", 'Yes -- you.', "Everyone in Jamrock. The cops, the criminals... Why do you think I'm holed up in here with a goddamn death ray, waiting for you?", 'One corrupt motherfucker with the disco pants and the funny tie. Agent to La Puta Madre.', "Nah. That I'm not planning to shoot you is the extent of the courtesy I can extend to La Puta Madre at present.", 'You know what I did. I fucked him over.', 'And now I have Harry Can-Opener in my lair. Fucking Titus...', 'Yeah. Other questions.', "Is that a joke or a threat? I'm guessing both.", 'Yeah, sure.', "I'm sure La Puta Madre himself will explain it all to you soon enough.", 'Of you? No, not really.', "Right, sure. You don't know.", "Oh yes, they do. The cops, the criminals... Why do you think I'm holed up in here with a goddamn death ray, waiting for you?", 'Yeah. You had your death squad with you. What happened to them, anyway?', "Sure you do, I bet they're just outside, waiting.", "I guess I'll take my chances.", "Well, it wasn't this scrawny dude.", "You had two guys and a lady. The guys looked pretty buff. Lady wasn't bad either.", 'One of the guys seemed chipper, a blond, the other had a brooding something-or-other about him... And the woman... the woman was the only one in uniform. All were carrying.', 'She narrows her eyes.', 'That sound about right?', "Fantastic. I've gotta get on the road -- then you can go find your friends... Unless you have anything *pressing* to ask me.", "I've faced worse.", 'She shrugs.', "Well, this has been a great talk, really. But I think I'm going to hit the road now.", 'What bunker?', "Don't know anything about it. No one's been around since I set up camp. But I'm sure I'm not the first vagabond to...", 'Her voice trails off into white noise in your head. It feels like an aneurysm approaching.', 'She looks at the machine, assessing the damage. Her hand trembles.', 'Ah, fuck it.', 'She puts the barrel of the gun into her mouth.', 'she mutters.', 'Oh, yes, it is.', 'She stares at you, frozen, the gun still in her mouth, eyes filled with dark intensity. Then something shifts in her.', 'Day of miracles...', "I'll take it.", 'She runs past you, then past the lieutenant, and disappears into the darkness of the tunnel.', 'She pulls the trigger before you finish your sentence.', 'You watch as her brains trickle out through her neon hair.', 'She flashes you an incredulous grin. Then she exhales sharply, shakes her head, and pulls the trigger.', 'A smirk crosses her face as she watches you stand there, mute. Then she exhales sharply, shakes her head, and pulls the trigger.', "I know it's bad -- try not to move.", "Look, I know this isn't very fun for you, so let's wrap this up. You have a tribunal to attend.", "There, there, I told you it's best not to move.", "Proximity to the Pale Compressor is overloading his mind. He'll be okay once it's off, though.", "What are you doing? I told you -- it's best not to move...", 'Glad to have been of assistance.', "Best of luck to you, officers -- Revachol's a bitch.", 'The woman runs past you and disappears into the darkness of the tunnel.', "You're big boys, you can handle it. Dialogues: ['The worker is in a deep slumber.', 'The man does not mind. You probably need them more than he does.', "It's a dockworker's ID, doubling as a shift card and a job permit. Better be quick!", 'The sleeping dockworker has little to say about your actions. He remains silent.', 'On the counter -- rolled out of his open hand -- you see a blister pack of headache medicine.', ', encircled by a logo with a tree.', 'Zzzz...', 'Zzz...  zzzzz... zzz...', 'Zzzzzzzz...']

You're saying... but there's no way... uh huh... yes, okay, I'm listening...", 'Alright, gendarme.', "Comrade Ulixes and I have conferred about it, and we've come up with an alternative way for you to convince us of your commitment to the group.", 'The young man gives his companion an uncertain glance. The companion nods his head vigorously.', 'I want you... to hit me.', 'Well, gendarme? What are we waiting for?', 'The young man staggers back into the couch, eyes agog and momentarily dazed, but not seriously hurt.', 'That... was *amazing*. Uli, perhaps we should tangle with the gendarmerie more often.', 'The young man rubs his cheek.', 'No, keep it. I feel... *great*, actually...', 'Perhaps we should tangle with the gendarmerie more often.', "I'm fine. Better than fine, actually.", 'Perhaps we should tangle with the gendarmerie more often.', 'Errrrck.', 'The young man cradles his jaw and looks up, his expression blank.', '*Sorry*? You nearly took my fucking jaw off!', "What lesson is that, huh? That the RCM are assholes? That they'll take your fucking jaw off?", "What? You're just gonna stand there after you nearly broke my fucking jaw?", 'The young man can hardly conceal his disappointment. He was apparently looking forward to being punched by you.', "Well, if you're not going to play along, I don't think we have anything further to discuss. Good evening to you, gendarme.", 'I do have to admire a certain tenacity, even when it seems to make no sense.', 'Oh, it *is*, and it only gets *more disco* from here...', 'Hmmm. I thought I perceived some *eschatological* air about you...', 'The young man sighs.', "God, it's so pitiful watching a grown man beg. I can hardly stand it.", "Yes, let's get right to it.", "... but if it's true that this individual possesses *so much capital* that light literally *bends* around him, then that must mean...", 'Well, on that note, I think we can call it an evening.', "What do you mean, 'is that it'? You've done the reading, we talked about it, what more do you expect from a reading group?", 'Well, you could always *ask*, I guess.', 'The two young men look at each other a moment.', "But it's getting late, so maybe pick the *most important* question?", 'Come on. We have things to do in the morning.', 'The young man waits patiently for you to finish.', 'Yes?', 'The young man considers your words for a minute.', "The theorists Puncher and Wattmann -- not infra-materialists, but theorists nonetheless -- say that communism is a secular version of Perikarnassian theology, that it replaces faith in the divine with faith in humanity's future...", "I have to say, I've never *entirely* understood what they mean, but I think maybe the answer is in there, somewhere.", "Only in this very specific sense. Communism doesn't dangle any promises of eternal bliss or reward. The only promise it offers is that the future can be better than the past, if we're willing to work and fight and die for it.", "Then you don't believe in the historic role of the proletariat, which also means you reject the basis of historical materialism.", 'Something else...', 'The young man shakes his head.', "I guess you could say we believe it *because it's impossible*.", "It's our way of saying we refuse to accept that the world has to remain... like this...", "Yes, that's a good way to think of it, broken, but not irreparable.", "A thought can be a very powerful thing. That's the whole idea of infra-materialism...", "You're right... We should clean this up and get going.", 'He gestures to the matchboxes.', "You've got to believe in *something*. Otherwise, what are you doing?", "Yes, that's a good way to think of it... a work-in-progress.", 'My mums.', "She works in one of those skyscrapers, but it's not like you think... she's a cleaning lady...", "But how did you... oh, never mind. I guess I'm easier to read than I thought...", "Because I always have. Though I try not to do it too often now... it's kind of embarrassing, isn't it?", "We all have to make sacrifices for the future. Maybe that's what I was trying to get at earlier...", "I want us *all* to live in a better world. But yes... she's a part of it... I guess we're all a part of it...", 'Yes, in fact... my mums.', "She works in La Delta... in one of those skyscrapers, but it's not like you think... she's a cleaning lady.", 'The young man appears lost inside his own thoughts...', "I'm not sure I get what you're driving at. Of course there will be a future, even if the form it takes might appear unrecognisable. That's the spiral of progress.", "Nobody said fulfilling the proletariat's historic role would be easy.", "It demands great faith with no promise of tangible reward. But that doesn't mean we can simply give up.", 'Even then.', 'Even then.', 'Especially then.', "The young man gives you a slightly confused look, as though he's sure you asked something else and he simply misheard.", 'Yes, I heard him. Give me a moment.', 'He takes a deep breath, then turns to you...', 'What makes you ask *that* question, above any other?', "Maybe your problem is that you think it's their job to *handle* you...", "You asked that question because you're still under the influence of ideology. That's natural. You're like a fish that's only now discovering that her whole life has been dictated by the movements of sea currents.", "That's what ideology is. It's like there are these invisible forces everywhere, pushing and tugging you this way and that, and you don't even know they're *there*.", 'Everything, man. That is part of the communist project, to destroy the ideological structures that reduce men and women to these hollow shells of identity.', 'Do you know the story of Dobreva and Abadanaiz?', 'Not just lovers, they were the Dual Commissars of Revolution in Insulinde.', 'Julia Dobreva came from Graad. Jean Abadanaiz was born in Revachol. She was brilliant, charismatic, a revolutionary comet. He was her partner and stabiliser, the planet who kept her in orbit.', "It's from them we get the notion of dual-leadership, the *décomptage*, Revachol's truly great contribution to revolutionary thought. I believe it even persists in some form in the RCM, even to this day.", "They died on their own terms, like real revolutionaries. There's a lot to say for that.", 'He sighs.', "There's more to it than that. People still make their own choices. It's a matter of being aware what's influencing them.", "Yes, that's the question you should be asking yourself.", 'The young man nods but says nothing. He appears to be distracted by something...', 'No. They were the Revolutionary Lovers, the Dual Commissars of Revolution in Insulinde.', "The so-called 'Revolutionary Lovers'. They were the Dual Commissars of Revolution in Insulinde.", "Of course it's possible. Just extremely difficult. You practically have to be a world-historical individual to do it.", "Maybe your problem is that you think they're *yours* to handle...", "Ah, gendarme. Your problem isn't ideological, it's personal...", "That's because your brain is floating in ideology, gendarme. It's practically drowning in it...", "Are you absolutely sure? A communist can't be afraid to ask questions, just because they don't know what the answer might be.", "It seems you're right, Uli. I should've listened to you.", 'He sighs, then turns to you.', "Now, if you'll excuse us, we have some *group business* to attend to.", 'More what?', "It seems like there's something on your mind. Maybe a question you mean to ask?", 'The young man turns to his companion, then back to you.', '*Or* it suggests that capital, in sufficient quantities, must exhibit its own plasm-like qualities...', "... but my question is where does the RCM *recruit* all these hyper-revolutionaries to join this 'Remote Viewers Division'?", 'Fascinating...', 'The young man ignores the lieutenant.', 'But I suppose it makes sense that some common strain of infra-materialist thought would persist in the RCM, even to this day, given its origins.', 'The young man nods thoughtfully.', 'But I suppose it makes sense that some common strain of infra-materialist thought would persist in the RCM, even to this day, given its origins.', '...', 'Undoubtedly.', 'The two phenomena are actually deeply intertwined.', 'Many infra-materialists believe that pale is actually a manifestation of nostalgia and historical inertia...', 'Those same theorists have hypothesised that revolution may in fact create a *counter-force* that prevents the pale from expanding.', "No-no-no. We're saying he doesn't *need* to open them, because he absorbs all the relevant content just by staring intently at the cover. It's a widely understood second-level effect...", "Sure, we're here most every night.", "Maybe we'll catch you again.", "Wait a minute, if you don't mind...", "We wanted to get your opinion on something: a few little changes we we've been thinking about.", 'Nothing *too major*, I think. We were talking, potentially, about relaxing some parts of our admissions process...', 'I thought so, too, but perhaps we overdid it, just a little...', 'There was another thing: We were also debating putting up some posters around town.', "Ah, it makes sense. There's already a sub-theme of radical street art running through our reading group...", "Plus, I've got the *perfect* place in mind...", "Put some more coffee on, Uli. We've got a long night ahead of us. We should probably get Cindy in here too...", 'Oh! And, gendarme. One last thing...', 'About that question you asked earlier. It reminded me of a certain poem that you might appreciate...', "It was written by a young communard who was killed on the barricades during the Coalition landings. The story goes that he wrote it on the last night of his life, keeping watch from the barricades in the middle of the night. I don't have the whole thing committed to memory, but there's a line in it I think about sometimes.", 'Anyway, goodnight to you.', "I've been thinking about what you asked before, about women, you know...", "Not that it's any of my business, but it sounds like this question is *really* tearing you up inside.", 'So, good luck with that, I guess.', 'Glad to hear it. I was thinking we might be able to get Cindy to design the posters...', "Oh, I *like* that. We're dismantling the structures of capital with their own tools...", "That's *exactly* what I was thinking...", 'Exactly! I was thinking we could print them in the old communard style, with huge slogans...', 'I suppose that would open us up to charges of hypocrisy... not to mention it might make us *look pretty desperate* for new members...', "Right. We'll have to table this question until we've considered the potential downstream effects.", "In any case, we've kept you long enough. Goodnight to you.", 'He sighs.', "You're right. It probably wouldn't *kill* us to read more conventional historical materialism.", "I'm not saying we abandon our beliefs. I just think it would be better if our group had more than *two* regular attendees.", "Plus, all these empty chairs are a little sad, aren't they?", "You're back.", 'The young man turns to you.', 'The gendarme returns.', 'What do you need?', "The two young men are either oblivious to or ignoring your entrance. Their attentions are fixed on whatever it is they're stacking in the middle of the floor...", "I think it's holding, Ulixes...", 'Careful, careful!', 'Damn. Hardly any difference...', 'The young man shakes his head, and then looks up at you with barely concealed irritation...', "You're late.", 'It certainly *looks* like my jacket, Ulixes. Where did you get that, gendarme?', "Yeah, I'm sure you did. That's real Saramirizian twill. Only old Saramirizian communists and drug smugglers wear those anymore...", "See, Uli? It's just like Mazov wrote. How does it go again?", "I assumed it was Maurice who broke into my room, to play a trick on me. I didn't think I'd *actually* been raided by the RCM!", 'Absolutely not. You have to keep it...', 'He turns to his companion.', "Can you imagine the look on Maurice's face when he finds out the RCM has been kicking my door down?", "And now they've shown up *in force* to break up our meeting!", 'He rubs his hands together excitedly.', 'The RCM wants to join us?', 'A quizzical expression...', "Interesting. Does that mean you've done the reading?", "You have? Excellent. Let's hear your critique then.", 'Characters? What characters are you talking about?', "Well, this is getting awkward. I'm not sure what you were expecting to find here then...", "They always say that when they haven't done the reading.", 'Too many... *words*?', "Yes, a revolutionary *reading* group. The most ideologically advanced materialist reading group in Martinaise. But it sounds like that's news to you...", "And now they've sent one of their agents to *infiltrate* our meeting.", 'He rubs his hands together excitedly.', "You're right. It's *better*!", 'Oh, gendarme, because this is perfect...', "You're right. It was a gift from my grandmother. But now you've *got* to keep it...", "Unlikely. That's real Saramirizian twill. Only old Saramirizian communists and drug smugglers wear those anymore...", "'Confiscated'? Next he's probably going to say it was civil asset forfeiture...", "That's the whole point, of course. We can't just have *anybody* waltzing in here. Martinaise is crawling with reactionary infiltrators.", 'There are RCM spies, for one. Just recently, someone even broke into my apartment, if you can believe it...', 'To say nothing of Gottwaldians and Econoclards.', "We all have to take precautions, especially during these delicate times. What matters is that you've made it, and that you've done the reading.", "Are you saying you *haven't* done the reading for tonight?", 'The two young men look at one another.', 'Mmmm.', 'The young man considers you a moment...', 'That girl from my seminar *promised* she would stop by.', 'Theory is the poetry of thought.', 'Maurice and Zuzanna will be back, I know it.', 'Who the hell took my jacket?', 'Kind of chilly tonight, Uli.', 'Puncher and Wattmann should be required reading.', "The only 'class' I care about is the working class.", "If infra-materialism is wrong, I don't want to be right.", 'My grades are trash this semester.', "We're the only real communists left.", 'An interesting point, Uli.']

Title: Disco Elysium
Dialogues: ['Oh, great.', 'What else do you need, detective?', 'You mean why did I leave the bar?', "Honestly, I'm... not really comfortable discussing it with you, sir.", 'I, uh...', "Let's just say I left because I needed to get away from someone.", 'You know whom.', "I *really* don't want to talk about this. Let's just forget about this, okay?", 'What?', 'No, why would you even think that?!', "*Please* don't bring Garte into this, it's none of your business!", "I already said I don't want to talk about this! You're messing everything up again!", "Maybe, I don't know...", 'I just know I have to take some time off right now.', 'No, not me.', 'What? Of course it bothered me! But I thought the Union already knew about the corpse.', 'No one calls the police.', 'The Union would get angry.', 'You know...', 'What the Union says, goes. People listen to them and they take care of their own, which is, like, everyone here.', 'Okay.', "She obviously doesn't want to challenge your authority. You feel *much* better now.", "I... I didn't want to get in trouble with the others...", "I... I didn't know I had to report it... I... I thought someone would take him down eventually...", 'Her voice breaks.', 'Breathing on the other end suggests that Sylvie is still on the line. She heard everything.', "There's no reply from the other end of the line.", 'You can almost hear the girl getting smaller on the other end of the line, until she almost drowns in static.', "Yes... I know, it's just...", 'Was there anything else?', "The other people who live around here. Local people. I... I didn't want trouble...", "You don't live here, you *don't* understand. Squealing is frowned upon here -- everything is dealt with... well, by the Union. Internally.", "Please, I just didn't want any trouble.", 'You do?', 'What else can I do for you?', "I don't know what to tell you, officer. I didn't call you, because I didn't want to get in trouble with the others, with the Union. I'm sorry about that.", 'Mhmh.', 'No...', "I honestly don't know.", 'You have to ask someone else. There are thousands of people in Martinaise.', "No, sorry... I don't.", 'Not a lot of people have phones around here. Copper thieves take the wires...', "People don't have the money to have the cables put in again. They use the Union's phone or the one on the coast.", 'Okay...', "She's calmer now. Probably because the focus has shifted elsewhere.", 'Yeah, go on.', "No, I don't know. It wasn't me...", "I haven't been out there since... I was terrified of the stench and the corpse.", "Yes, I know who you are. You're a police officer... *the law*.", "You told me back in the Whirling... you told *everybody*. And showed us your badge... I don't need to hear about it anymore.", "Oh... no, I haven't, sorry.", "Please, no. Not this again -- everyone saw your 'cool gun', detective...", 'She sounds beyond exacerbated.', 'You were trying to *impress* some people with it. Everyone was eating and...', 'She stops hesitantly, not sure if she should continue.', "You were waving it around in everyone's face, begging them to describe it. You said it 'calms you'. And then you started making suicide jokes. It got pretty *graphic*.", "No, please, no more suicide threats! Thank *god* you don't have that stupid gun anymore...", 'There is silence on the other end of the line.', 'Me neither.', "No idea. All I know is, next you were waving around money instead. Saying things like 'Big bucks cannot lie' and 'Guns can't buy money, but money can always buy guns'.", 'It almost looked like you pawned it, but believe me, I did *not* ask.', 'She sighs.', 'Great.', 'Anything else?', 'Uniform? I never saw you in any uniform, you had your... *things* on. The disco things.', "Yes, I'm sure. Every time we talk about it I'm going to be *more* sure I don't know.", 'Sorry about that.', 'Anything else, detective?', 'I, ugh... the ones I had to wrench out of your toilet?', 'Yes. You put *something* there. Causing bad water damage in the kitchen. I think it was that.', "I... dammit, I don't remember what I did to your damn papers! I don't remember every little thing I do...", 'Resentment gives way to concern in her voice.', "Especially when there's a hurricane loose. It's your fault for losing them -- not mine.", 'Well.', "You tried to jam it down the toilet, sir, clogging it completely. After I had *unclogged* the toilet and retrieved the paperwork I threw it out in the trash, thinking you didn't need it.", 'I am sorry about that.', 'Anything else, detective?', 'No, absolutely not.', "I do hope so. Please don't call me again. Bye.", "She's ready to hang up.", "I'm not mad, it's just...", 'You were so drunk and so emotional all the time, and then the *skua thing* happened. It just made me want to quit.', "The stuffed bird. The great skua. You threw it against the wall, while screaming 'fuck that bird' and laughing like a maniac.", 'I think you said it had been *giving you shit ever since you got there*.', "Didn't seem like you had fun doing it though.", 'Yes, well...', "The static on the radio suggests Sylvie doesn't have a comment.", "That's wonderful, really. Maybe you should keep pursuing that hobby. Maybe it would calm you down a little.", 'Okay, officer...', "Her voice is withdrawing as if she's moving away from the speaker.", 'It was a pretty bird, there since I started working in the Whirling. I really liked her. We called her Scotty...', "Yes, obviously. You were the worst client I've ever seen. And I have seen *so many* assholes in this place...", "I've had sailors fighting, Union guys grabbing my ass, kids stealing booze. Once a guy was glued to the karaoke machine every night for two months. But *you*...", 'She pauses.', 'Well... You were worse than all of them. Honestly, you were getting borderline aggressive.', 'Even about little things, like not turning down the volume at 3 AM. I even *liked* one of those songs you kept listening to on repeat. No more. I hate it now.', "'We Go On' by the OO.", "I can't listen to it anymore, you've turned it into a parody.", 'To hell with that song...', 'Then there was your room. Your *project*, an experiment to see how bad it can get in there.', "I tried to send the cleaner, but you wouldn't let me. Threatened to 'make me understand'. I had no idea what you meant -- and I *don't* want to know.", 'And then you screamed something incomprehensible about churches and the scent of apricots and aquariums.', 'She takes a deep breath.', 'And *then* I had to deal with your toilet. The one you clogged with *police documents*, causing water damage downstairs in the kitchen.', "I won't even *mention* you waving your gun around, harassing customers, *threatening* to sing karaoke, threatening to kill yourself...", 'I, ugh... the ones I had to wrench out of your toilet.', "Good. Then it's not lost.", "Just don't throw it in the toilet again. Toilets don't work like that.", "No, you really weren't. You were simply the worst.", "God, I... I knew I shouldn't have brought it up. Just... try not to call me again and let's pretend it never happened.", "I... dammit, I don't remember what I did to your damn papers! I don't remember every little thing I do.", 'Resentment gives way to concern in her voice.', "Especially when there's a hurricane loose. It's *your* fault for losing them -- not mine.", 'I bet.', 'Wait, really? No, this is absolutely not true. I like Garte, I really do.', "No, I was actually flattered, I've always liked him. It was just bad timing... with the corpse and all that.", "There's a pause. You can almost see her on the other side, the telephone cord coiled around her index.", "I didn't know *what* to say to him later. Then you came and destroyed the place. So I left without explaining. I should have told him maybe...", "Okay, but... please don't mess it up. Please don't take out your gun or something.", 'Right. Well... Are we almost done now, officer?', 'Oh, all sorts of things. Some disco, rock too. So much disco and rock...', "Yes. That's the one you liked to sing along to the *most*. The later it got the more *that one* came on.", 'Which one would that be?', '. Butchered that right up...', 'All sorts of things. The OO. Some disco, rock too. So much disco and rock...', 'No. What?', 'Oh god.', 'Please just stay out of my li...', '...', 'Oh, right...', 'Hello, officer, what can I do for you?', 'Yes, hello!', "A female voice greets you through static -- it sounds like she's million miles away from here.", 'Yes, hello.', 'You recognize her voice.']

Title: Disco Elysium
Dialogues: ['The old man stares at the reeds. His face shows no emotion -- only a faint tremor passes over his features, like a leaf in the wind.', 'What is it?', "What do you want from me? I can't go...", "The old man stares despondently at the logs. It's like he's forgotten you're there...", '*Real music, real proletkult*.', "That's La Revacholière, not your rock-and-roll misanthropy. *Chanson de soldat* of the black-and-whites.", 'The job of a shit-licker.', 'There you go.', 'One of three.', "In Graad they sang 'Brave Children, Favourites of History' and in Hsin-Yao it was...", '...some Samaran shit, I guess.', 'I fucking know what they sang!', 'I watched those little fuckers die in my arms -- little ones came to help us. Got cut to shreds...', "You don't fucking tell me what they sang...", 'He closes his eyes and exhales to calm himself.', 'Everyone has. They named a fucking perfume after it.', 'Talked to *her*?', 'He raises his bushy brow and looks down from the sky -- straight into your bloodshot eye.', "It's the *drugs* you're all on. Druggies, winos, and whores...", 'He closes his eyes in disgust.', "I've seen kids lose their minds and start *talking* to the city. Asking it to *protect* them, when the shelling gets bad. Calling it La Revacholière...", "Cities can't talk. It's bourgeois idealism... I don't wanna talk about this shit anymore.", "God's shithouse.", "Should've taken it down like they did in Graad; dismantled it for firewood.", 'Doubt it, dog...', 'A fucking perfume...', 'he sighs.', 'How did it go...', 'He looks at his gun in your hand and shakes his head slowly.', "Something about shooting *rabbits,* I don't know... I can't remember. It doesn't matter. It's gone now.", 'What are you talking about?', 'He squints and looks you straight in the eye -- two black beads, moist from the sea air.', 'He squints and looks you straight in the eye -- two black beads, moist from the sea air.', 'How did it go...', 'He looks at his gun on the ground and shakes his head slowly.', '. The old man squints and looks you straight in the eye -- two black beads, moist from the sea air.', 'It is the anthem of the World Revolution.', 'One of three.', "You don't understand *anything*.", 'The old man squints at you -- you see two black beads, gleaming.', 'The job of a boujee dog.', "Real music. It's La Revacholière, you shit-licking boujee dog. *Chanson de soldat* of the black-and-whites.", 'His gaze follows your motions. The rifle feels surprisingly light in your hand, frame stocked and patched in places with tape and wire.', "The rifle's in a shabby state, like a crutch that's seen too much travel. Hieroglyphs are embossed into the forearm made of walnut.", "That's what the little guys told us.", "Every day at 4 o'clock in the morning, they'd go on and on about their Safre, their mankind, and Mazov...", "Those men were commandos. They weren't shit on a stick, like us. They were small and...", "He doesn't say more. The thought dissipates on his lips.", 'On the butt you see Vespertine writing, burnt into the wood: Triangong 4.46 mm, made in Hsin-Yao.', 'No response from the old man. The plastic cape around his shoulders rustles in a small bout of wind.', 'The old man blinks slowly. A strange jitter comes over him, he pushes his right leg down and does not reply.', 'Hmhm.', 'The old man smacks his lips.', 'The old man does not answer. He just stares in front of him.', "Things keep falling apart if you don't tend to them.", 'The old man keeps following your motions with his gaze. His right arm twitches suddenly...', 'My name...', '...is Iosef Lilianovich Dros, Political Commissar of the 114th Anti-Aircraft Division of the 4th Army of the Commune of Revachol.', 'I am a deserter, a partisan, and a prisoner of war. This is my termless surrender.', 'His eyes turn to the reeds again, dead and dull.', "From the Insulindian Citizens Militia -- the Army of the Revolution. I was recruited in Jamrock in '07, trained in the Ecole de Contrôle Aérien and consigned to emergency defence duties in '08.", 'I left my unit on the eve of the Landing. When I returned here on May 14th the Commune had fallen. Still armed -- and *ideologically trained* -- I wrote a criticism of myself. And resumed partisan duties.', 'No.', "I've been on other islands too.", "I was on Résurrection until they turned it into a *spa* in '18. Then I was on E48, a nameless sound, until the sea washed over it. Then I came back here. That was...", 'Twenty-two years ago.', 'Forty-three years and 10 months.', "It's not how a human being should live, but I had to...", "...I couldn't just forget. I couldn't just forget what I saw.", 'He nods.', 'Hiding, fishing, waiting...', 'He looks across the water.', 'Always waiting.', 'The old man turns his eyes from the shore and back to you.', 'For her to return.', 'Girl Child Revolution.', 'Always...', 'The material base for an uprising has eroded.', 'The working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'The historic opportunity for a revolution has passed. It will not come back anymore. However hard I try, whatever I do.', 'I have done everything a man can do. What have *you* done?', 'Survive?', 'For *what*?', 'What *can* I do?', 'The old man suddenly looks around, suddenly confused.', 'There is no flame to fan.', 'There is nothing left -- of the world, of our dreams.', 'I just *mourn*.', 'He stares right through you. Then blinks again.', 'The old man suddenly looks around, confused.', 'What *can* I do? What is there...', 'A waste.', 'The material base for an uprising has eroded, the working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'Good.', 'The material base for an uprising has eroded, the working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'No.', 'The material base for an uprising has eroded, the working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'No -- this is a vulgar criticism.', 'The material base for an uprising has eroded, the working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'I am not a fool.', 'I know -- the material base for an uprising has eroded. The working class has betrayed mankind...', "It won't.", 'The material base for an uprising has eroded, the working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'They have *you*.', 'The material base for an uprising has eroded, the working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'Women *are* more susceptible to bourgeois morals.', 'The material base for an uprising has eroded, the working class has betrayed mankind and themselves...', 'Always waiting.
